AnimatedList.description: See `AnimatedListInner`: the generic cast keeps `ref` and the item type together.

props.name: getKey
props.description: A stable key per item (an id, not the index).

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (item: T, state: PresenceState, index: number) => React.ReactNode
props.description: The content of one row. `state` is `"enter"`, `"idle"` or `"exit"` (an exiting row is a copy of its last render).

props.name: as
props.description: The list element: `ul` and `ol` wrap each row in an `li`. Default `ul`.

props.name: collapse
props.description:
Let the neighbours close the gap as a removed row collapses (a `0fr` track, no measuring): `true` or `"height"` for
a column, `"width"` for a wrapping row of chips. Default true. Put spacing inside the rows (padding or margin on the
content), not as a `gap` between them, or the gap jumps when the row finally unmounts.

props.name: exitDuration
props.description: Milliseconds a removed row stays while it leaves. Default 200, the speed of `animate-fade-out` and the collapse.

props.name: flip
props.description:
Slide the siblings to their new place when rows are inserted, removed or reordered (`useFlip`; `true` or its
options). With `collapse` the gap of a leaving row closes by itself, so it adds inserts and reorders; with
`collapse={false}` the rows below slide up when a leaving row finally unmounts. Off under reduced motion. Default false.

props.name: initial
props.description: Animate the rows of the first render too. Default false.

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Class names for every row wrapper.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Rows added in one update enter one after the other (`--sutra-stagger`). Default true.

AnimatedNumber.description:
A number whose digits roll to their new values, in tabular figures. Each digit is a column of 0 to 9 slid with a CSS
transition, so the first render shows the value without motion and reduced motion shows changes at once. Screen
readers get the formatted value once as text (the columns are hidden from them, and from copy and paste); add
`aria-live="polite"` to announce changes. Numbers only: format other values yourself.

props.name: animate
props.description: Roll the digits when `value` changes. `false` renders plain formatted text. Default true.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds for a digit to roll. Defaults to the fill speed token (`--sutra-duration-fill`).

props.name: format
props.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options (currency, percent, compact, fraction digits …).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale. Pass one explicitly when the server and the browser must agree (SSR). Defaults to the runtime locale.

Arrow / Home / End keys on the strip, and the slide in view as `value` (found with an IntersectionObserver, so a free
scroll updates it). It follows the ARIA carousel pattern: `aria-roledescription="carousel"` and "slide" with "n of N"
names, and a status line that announces the slide unless it is rotating. `autoplay` pauses while the pointer or focus is inside, has a visible
pause button (WCAG 2.2.2) and stays off under reduced motion until the user starts it. Controlled or uncontrolled.

props.description: Placeholder slide and `aria-busy` while the slides are on their way.

props.description: A bar that fills over the autoplay interval (a CSS transition, hidden under reduced motion). Default false.

props.description: Classes for each slide: its width (`basis-4/5` to show the next slide peeking). Default `basis-full`.

props.description: Index of the slide in view.

CheckBurst.description:
A tiny celebratory pop for completing a task or reaching a streak: a ring of particles flies out of the centre and fades
(Web Animations on `translate`, `scale` and `opacity`, no keyframes in the stylesheet), and the content swells. Pure
decoration: the layer is `aria-hidden` and never carries information, so say the result in text (a live region, the
checked state). Under `prefers-reduced-motion` nothing plays. It draws past its own box, so keep it out of an
`overflow-hidden` ancestor. Drive it with `active`, `burstKey` or `apiRef.burst()`.

props.name: active
props.description: A burst plays when this goes from false to true (never on mount).

props.name: apiRef
props.description: Imperative handle (`burst()`).

props.name: burstKey
props.description: A burst plays whenever this value changes (a streak count).

props.name: children
props.description: What the burst belongs to (a checkbox, a streak flame). It swells with the burst unless `pop` is false. Optional: with no children the burst fills its positioned parent.

props.name: count
props.description: Number of particles, 0 to 24. Default 10.

props.name: duration
props.description: Milliseconds. Default 500.

props.name: onBurst
props.description: Called when a burst is asked for, also where reduced motion keeps it from showing.

props.name: onBurstEnd
props.description: Called when the particles are gone.

props.name: particleSize
props.description: Particle size in px (a dash is 1.8 times as long). Default 5.

props.name: pop
props.description: Swell the children with the burst. Default true.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far the particles fly, in px from the centre. Default 28.

props.name: tone
props.description: `"multi"` cycles brand, success, warning and info; a tone paints them all in one colour. Default "multi".

CollapsibleContent.description: Animated panel of a `Collapsible`. Padding goes on the inner box so the closed height is 0.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Override the root's `keepMounted` for this panel.

CollapsibleTrigger.description: Button that toggles its `Collapsible`; sets `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child (your own button) and only add the ARIA wiring and click handling.

props.name: icon

Combobox.description: Searchable select built on Popover + cmdk, with multi-select chips and creatable options.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show a clear button while something is selected; Delete also clears (Backspace too, when single).

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the clear button. Default "Clear".

props.name: confirmBackspace
props.description:
Multiple only: Backspace on the focused field first marks the last chip (announced politely) and a second press
removes it, so a held key cannot empty the field. Default false: Backspace removes the last chip at once.

props.name: creatable
props.description: Offer "Create …" when the query matches no option.

props.name: defaultInputValue
props.description: Initial search text when uncontrolled.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when the query matches nothing. Default "No results".

props.name: filter
props.description:
How options are matched against the search text. Omit for the built-in fuzzy match. `false` shows `options` exactly
as given (server-side search: pass the results for the current `inputValue`). A function keeps the options it accepts.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: The search text, to control it (for async search). Cleared to "" when the list closes.

props.name: loading
props.description: Options are being fetched: shows a loading row (or a spinner beside the search text while options are on screen).

props.name: loadingState
props.description: Text of the loading row. Default "Loading…".

props.name: maxChips
props.description: Max chips shown in the trigger before collapsing into "+N" (multiple only).

props.name: onCreate
props.description:
Called with the query when the user picks "Create …". The new value is selected
automatically: return a different string (e.g. a generated id) to select that instead.

props.name: onInputValueChange
props.description: Called as the search text changes. Debounce the fetch on your side (see `useDebouncedValue`).

props.name: openOnFocus
props.description: Open the list when the field gets keyboard focus (pointer clicks keep their normal toggle).

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the combobox required. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Hide the search input.

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

Command.description: Command palette root (cmdk). Handles filtering and keyboard navigation.

one Kbd per entry (e.g. ["⌘", "N"]); any other node (or a glyph string like "⌘N") renders as text.

CommandList.description:
Scrollable results list; animates its height as results change. While no item matches, the (then option-less)
listbox is hidden and the `CommandEmpty` message shows in a polite live region beside it, because a listbox without
options is invalid ARIA.

Use `ComposerToolbar` when you need the named slots or overflow collapse, `PromptInputToolbar` otherwise.

props.description: Dates that can't be picked (react-day-picker matchers).

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Options passed to `Intl.DateTimeFormat`. Defaults to `{ dateStyle: "medium" }`.

props.name: formatRange
props.description: Custom formatter for the trigger text.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale passed to `Intl.DateTimeFormat`.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Number of months shown side by side.

props.name: presets
props.description: Sidebar presets. Pass `[]` to hide the sidebar.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the picker required. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

DateTimePicker.description:
Input-like button that opens a calendar plus a `TimePicker` to pick a local date and time.
Time-zone agnostic: the value is wall-clock time in the user's zone, like `datetime-local`.

props.name: captionLayout
props.description: Show month/year dropdowns in the calendar caption.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show an inline button that resets the value.

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: Time used when a day is picked before any time is set. Default `"00:00"`.

props.name: disabledDates
props.description: Dates that can't be picked (react-day-picker matchers).

props.name: doneLabel
props.description: Label of the button that closes the popover. Default "Done".

props.name: formatDateTime
props.description: Custom formatter for the trigger text; overrides `formatOptions`.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Options passed to `Intl.DateTimeFormat`. Defaults to `{ dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" }`.

props.name: granularity
props.description: Add a seconds segment. Default `"minute"`.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Force a 12- or 24-hour clock. Defaults to the locale's convention.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale passed to `Intl.DateTimeFormat`.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest selectable moment.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest selectable moment. Days before it are disabled and times are clamped.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (value: Date | undefined, meta: { localValue: string }) => void
props.description: Called with the new local date-time; `meta.localValue` is the same moment as `"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm"` (`""` when cleared).

props.name: presets
props.description: Quick picks shown in a sidebar ("In 1 hour", "Tomorrow 9:00"). Choosing one sets the value and closes.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the picker required. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes moved by the minute segment's arrow keys.

props.name: timeLabel
props.description: Label next to the time field. Default "Time".

props.name: value
props.description: A `Date`, or a local `"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm"` string (what `<input type="datetime-local">` uses).

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

DecodeText.description: Scramble-then-decode text reveal. Exposed as `role="img"` labelled with the final text, so screen readers never hear the scramble; reduced motion shows it instantly.

props.name: text
props.description: Final text. Also the accessible name.

props.name: charset
props.description: Characters used for the scramble.

props.name: duration
props.description: Total duration, ms. Default 900.

props.name: interval
props.description: Frame interval, ms. Default 40.

props.name: play
props.description: Bump to replay when `trigger="manual"`.

props.name: trigger
props.description: When to play: on mount, on hover/focus, or only when `play` changes. Default "mount".

DelegateToolBody.description: Body for a "delegate" tool call: one row per child task with status and an open button.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Opens the child's transcript.

DeleteConfirmDialog.description: Destructive confirmation with a featured warning icon and type-to-confirm input.

props.name: confirmText
props.description: Text the user must type to enable the delete button. Pass "" to skip.

props.name: consequences
props.description: Bullet points describing what will be lost.
props.default: ["12 projects and 348 tasks", "96 notes and their history", "2.4 GB of files"]

props.name: description
props.default: "This will permanently delete the Northwind Studio workspace for everyone. This action cannot be undone."

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`).

DeliveryTargetPicker.description: Where a job's results go: the local inbox, a messaging platform, an email, a GitHub comment or a webhook.

props.name: onConfigureChannels
props.description: Shows a "Channels" button in the home-channel warning.

props.name: platforms
props.description: Platforms offered, in order.

props.name: status
props.description: Per-platform connection state and home channel.

DeviceBatteryList.description:
Bluetooth device batteries: a summary card (connected count, lowest battery, away devices, settings link)
over a table of devices by kind, with nested rows for separately charged parts.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the icon chips and the settings link. Default "cyan".

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `devices` is empty. Default "No Bluetooth devices".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the devices table. Default "Device batteries".

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way. With no devices yet the summary and table show placeholders; with devices the root is only marked busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder device rows while loading. Default 3.

props.name: onOpenSettings
props.description: Called when the settings action is used (renders a button when there is no `settingsHref`).

props.name: settingsHref
props.description: Link for the settings action in the header.

props.name: settingsLabel
props.description: Settings action text. Default "Bluetooth Settings".

props.name: showAway
props.description: List away (paired, not connected) devices too, dimmed. Default true.

props.name: summary
props.description: Replaces the computed summary sentence.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title. Default "{n} connected".

DeviceFrame.description: Wraps content in browser window chrome or a phone/tablet bezel.

props.name: screenClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the screen/content area.

props.name: statusBar
props.description: Show a status bar with time and indicators (phone/tablet).

props.name: trafficLights
props.description: Colored traffic-light buttons (browser). Neutral dots when false.

props.name: url
props.description: Address bar text (browser).

DeviceIcon.description: One glyph per kind of device; unrecognised types fall back to a desktop monitor.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label; decorative (aria-hidden) when omitted.

props.name: type
props.description: tv, phone, tablet, laptop, desktop, speaker, browser, cast (case-insensitive aliases accepted).

DevicePairingFlow.description: Wallet "link a new device": QR + 8-digit code with a 2-minute TTL, then a "Do these match?" SAS check on both devices.

props.name: side
props.description: `existing` shows the QR + code; `new` types the code.

DeviceSessionList.description: Devices & sessions manager: list, per-session sign out, and "sign out everywhere else".

props.name: emptyDescription
props.default: "Devices appear here after they sign in."

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Replaces the whole empty state (overrides `emptyTitle` / `emptyDescription`).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows skeleton rows. `sessions == null` is treated as loading too.

props.name: onRevokeOthers
props.description: Shows "Sign out all other sessions" (with a confirm dialog) when there are other sessions.

DeviceSessionRow.description: One device/session with icon, details, "This device" badge and an inline-confirmed sign out.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for "last active" (handy for tests and SSR).

props.name: onRevoke
props.description: Sign this session out. May return a promise; the row shows a spinner until it settles.

DevServerList.description: Running dev servers by project: ports, activity ("working", "idle 2 hours"), memory, and a banner to stop idle ones.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for icons and port badges. Default "orange".

props.name: formatBytes
props.description: Memory text. Default decimal units ("458 MB", "1.18 GB").

props.name: idleAfterMs
props.description: A `running` server idle this long counts as idle. Default 30 minutes.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list. Default "Dev servers".

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way. With no projects yet the list shows placeholder rows; with projects the root is only marked busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder rows while loading. Default 3.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for idle and uptime text (pass it for deterministic output). Default: the live clock, refreshed every 30 seconds.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Makes the project name a button.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Stops one server (after confirmation). May return a promise; the dialog waits for it.

props.name: onStopIdle
props.description: Stops every idle server (after confirmation from the banner's "Stop All…").

props.name: showIdleBanner
props.description: Show the "running but idle" banner when some servers are idle. Default true.

Dialog.description:
Modal dialog root.

Dialog vs Sheet vs Drawer: `Dialog` is a centred modal (a bottom sheet on phones) for a focused task or decision;
`Sheet` slides in from an edge for navigation, detail or filter panels; `Drawer` (`./drawer`) is a touch-first
bottom sheet with drag-to-dismiss and snap points. Use `AlertDialog` / `ConfirmDialog` for interrupting confirmations.

DialogContent.description: Dialog panel: centered modal on desktop, bottom sheet on mobile.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show the top-right close button. Default true.

DialogFooter.description: Action row; stacks full-width on mobile.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Separate the footer with a top border and subtle background.

DialogHeader.description: Title block with optional featured icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Featured icon shown above the title.

DialogProvider.description:
Mount once near the root to enable `useDialogs()`: promise-based `confirm`, `prompt` and `choose`
built on `ConfirmDialog` and `Dialog`. One dialog shows at a time; later calls wait in a queue.

DictionaryCard.description: Dictionary entry: word, phonetic, frequency and senses grouped by part of speech with examples.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra header actions (a SpeakButton is added for `lang` automatically).

DiffCard.description: Compact diff preview card: file header with stats, capped unified diff, expand and optional accept / reject.

props.name: path
props.description: File path shown in the header.

props.name: collapsedLines
props.description: Visible lines before the preview is capped. Default 12.

props.name: context
props.description: Unchanged lines kept around each change. Default 3.

props.name: fileStatus
props.description: new-file / deleted-file presentation. Inferred from empty old/new values when omitted.

props.name: headerExtra
props.description: Extra header content (right side, before the stat).

props.name: onOpen
props.description: When set, "Click to expand" calls this (e.g. open a full diff editor) instead of expanding inline.

props.name: onPathClick
props.description: Makes the path a button (e.g. open the file).

props.name: pathHref
props.description: Makes the path a link.

DiffStat.description: "+12 −3" change summary with a tiny proportional bar.

props.name: blocks
props.description: Number of blocks in the bar. Default 5.

props.name: showBar
props.description: Proportional block bar. Default true.

DiffViewer.description:
Text comparison: inline (track-changes style, word-level inside changed lines) or split
side-by-side with line numbers. Collapses unchanged regions, colors changes by author and
navigates changes with n / p (or j / k, ] / [).

props.name: activeChange
props.description: Current change (controlled).

props.name: authors
props.description: Author id → name/color, for attribution coloring.

props.name: changeAuthors
props.description: Author id per change index (when not given on `segments`).

props.name: collapseUnchanged
props.description: Collapse long unchanged regions. Default true.

props.name: context
props.description: Unchanged lines kept around each change. Default 3.

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: Initial layout when uncontrolled; also shows the Inline / Split toggle.

props.name: font
props.description: Monospace (code) or sans (prose). Default "mono".

props.name: granularity
props.description: Detail inside changed lines. Default "word".

props.name: headerExtra
props.description: Extra header content (right side).

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Line numbers in inline mode. Default false (split always shows them).

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrolling body (CSS length).

props.name: mode
props.description: Layout (controlled). Default "inline".

props.name: oldLabel
props.description: Labels for the split columns.

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Shows an Inline / Split toggle in the header.

props.name: segments
props.description: Precomputed (e.g. server-side, author-attributed) comparison; overrides old/new values.

props.name: showHeader
props.description: Header with counts and next/previous. Default true.

DirectionProvider.description:
Tells Sutra and its Radix primitives which way the text runs. Put one at the app root (no `dir`: it follows `<html dir>`
live) or wrap a subtree with a `dir` to force it; read it with `useDirection`.

props.name: children
props.description: The subtree that reads the direction.

props.name: dir
props.description:
Force the direction of this subtree. It renders a `display: contents` element carrying `dir`, so logical utilities,
`rtl:` variants and Radix keyboard handling all follow it, and nests (a chart can force `ltr` inside an RTL page).
Omit it to follow the document (`<html dir>`) and render no element.

DividedGrid.description:
One bordered, rounded box whose cells are separated by hairlines instead of being separate cards: a tool grid, a feature
list, a set of options. Works for any number of cells: the box clips the last column's and row's lines, so a short last row
leaves no stray divider.

props.name: children
props.description: `DividedGridItem`s. Anything else is wrapped in a cell as it is.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns at the widest size: 1 → 2 → `columns` as the space grows. Default 3.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown instead of the cells when there are none (and nothing is loading).

props.name: items
props.description: Data-driven alternative to `children`; both can be mixed (items first).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no cells, placeholder cells stand in; with cells, the root is marked busy.

props.name: loadingCells
props.description: Placeholder cells shown while loading with no cells. Default: two rows.

props.name: numbered
props.description: Show "01", "02" … in each cell.

props.name: query
props.description: What `columns` measures: the viewport (default) or the grid's own width (CSS container queries, cells stay at least about 200px wide), for grids beside a sidebar.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for cells with an `href`.

DividedGridItem.description: One cell of a `DividedGrid`: icon tile, title, description, badge and meta. A link, a button or static, depending on `href` and `onSelect`.

props.name: badge
props.description: A short label next to the title ("New", "Beta"). Text is shown in a `Badge`; pass a node to style it yourself.

props.name: description
props.description: Up to three lines; longer text is clamped.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the cell a link. Unsafe URLs (`javascript:`) are ignored and the cell stays static.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon shown in a small tile above the title (decorative: the title names the cell).

props.name: meta
props.description: Small muted line at the bottom of the cell ("12 MB limit").

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when the cell is clicked (after `onClick`, unless that prevented the default). Alone it makes the cell a button; with `href` it runs before the link opens.

DividerPill.description: Horizontal rule with a centered pill, e.g. "Teleported from web" or a checkpoint marker.

props.name: action
props.description: Trailing action inside the pill, e.g. a "Restore" link.

DocsHeader.description: Documentation header: logo, version switcher, links, ⌘K search, GitHub and theme toggle.

props.name: links
props.default: [ { label: "Guides", href: "#guides" }, { label: "Components", href: "#components" }, { label: "Blocks", href: "#blocks" }, { label: "API", href: "#api" }, ]

props.name: theme
props.description: Current color mode. When uncontrolled the header toggles the `dark` class on <html>.

DocsSidebar.description: Documentation navigation with filterable collapsible sections (or a TreeView).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially active link id when uncontrolled. Default "installation".

props.name: mode
props.description: `sections`: collapsible groups of links. `tree`: a keyboard-navigable TreeView.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the id of the link the user navigates to.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a filter field at the top.

props.name: value
props.description: Currently active link id.

DocumentOutline.description: Heading tree of a document: indented by level, active highlight, click to jump, optional filter.

props.name: activeId
props.description: `id` (or `line-<n>`) of the current heading.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no headings.

props.name: filterable
props.description: Show a filter box. Default: when there are more than 8 headings.

props.name: maxLevel
props.description: Deepest level listed. Default 6.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading shown above the list. Default "Outline"; `null` hides it.

DonutChart.description: Donut (ring) chart with segments, center label, toggleable legend and tooltip.

props.name: index
props.description: Key of the segment name.

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Small caption under the center value.

props.name: centerValue
props.description: Center value. Defaults to the formatted total. Pass null to hide.

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors in segment order (defaults to the chart palette).

props.name: iconFor
props.description: Icon per segment (an app icon) shown in the legend rows. Setting it switches the legend to a `BreakdownList`.

props.name: legendInteractive
props.description: Let legend entries toggle segments. Default true.

props.name: legendValues
props.description:
Show values in the legend: it becomes a `BreakdownList` (one row per segment, value right-aligned).
`true` / `"value"`: the formatted value; `"percent"`: the share of the visible total; `"both"`: value and percent.
Default false (the compact chip legend).

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no data, a placeholder ring (and legend) of the same size; with data, the root is marked busy.

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between segments in degrees. Default 1.5.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px. Default 200.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Ring thickness in px. Default size × 0.14.

props.name: valueKey
props.description: Key of the segment value. Default "value".

DownloadBadge.description: Weights cache state on `Badge`: downloading 42% (with bar), cached, partial, failed, not downloaded.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–100 for downloading / partial.

props.name: size
props.description: Size text, e.g. "54 GB".

Drawer.description:
Bottom sheet with drag-to-dismiss, optional snap points, scroll lock and focus return (Radix Dialog).

Dialog vs Sheet vs Drawer: `Dialog` is a centred modal for a focused task or decision; `Sheet` is a panel
that slides in from any edge (side navigation, detail or filter panels); `Drawer` is a touch-first bottom sheet
with a grabber, drag-to-dismiss and snap points. Drawer's Header, Title, Description, Body and Footer are the
Sheet parts with drawer spacing.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Allow closing by drag, Escape and scrim click. Default true.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal (scroll lock, focus trap, inert page). Default true.

props.name: snapPoint
props.description: Active snap point (one of `snapPoints`).

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Heights as fractions of the viewport, e.g. `[0.5, 1]`. Omit for a content-sized sheet.

DrawerBody.description: Scrollable content area. A drag never starts here while it is scrolled down. `SheetBody` with drawer spacing.

DrawerClose.description: Closes the drawer when clicked (works even when `dismissible={false}`).

DrawerContent.description: The sheet panel: grabber, drag-to-dismiss (80px or a fast flick), rubber-band upward, snap points.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Show a top-right close button. Default false.

props.name: showHandle
props.description: Show the grabber handle. Default true.

DrawerFooter.description: Action row pinned to the bottom of the sheet. `SheetFooter` with a top border and drawer spacing.

DrawerHeader.description: Pinned header (does not scroll with the body); drag it to move the sheet. `SheetHeader` with drawer spacing.

DrawerTrigger.description: Element that opens the drawer (same as `SheetTrigger`).

DropdownMenu.description: Dropdown menu root: Radix `DropdownMenu.Root` with the reading direction filled in.

DropdownMenuCheckboxItem.description: Toggleable item with a check indicator.

DropdownMenuItem.description: Actionable menu row with optional icon, description and shortcut.

props.name: tone
props.description: `destructive` colours the row red for dangerous actions. Default `neutral`.

DropdownMenuShortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut hint aligned to the right of an item.

DropdownMenuSubTrigger.description: Item that opens a nested sub-menu.

Dropzone.description: Drag-and-drop file area that also opens the file picker on click, Enter or Space.

props.name: currentCount
props.description: Files already selected elsewhere, counted against `maxFiles`.

props.name: density
props.description: `compact` is a single-row layout for tight spaces. Default `normal`.

props.name: directory
props.description:
Upload whole folders: clicking opens a folder picker (`webkitdirectory`) and dropped folders are
walked recursively. Every file is validated on its own and carries its `relativePath`
(see `getFileRelativePath`). Where the browser can't pick folders, clicking falls back to the file
picker and the hint says why.

props.name: hint
props.description: Defaults to a description of `accept` / `maxSize`.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for the underlying file input.

props.name: onDrop
props.description: Called with accepted files and rejections after a drop or pick.

EditorStatusBar.description: Editor footer: save status and presence on the left; counts, reading time, cursor and mode on the right.

props.name: characters
props.description: Explicit character count (overrides `text`).

props.name: cursor
props.description: 1-based cursor position.

props.name: mode
props.description: Mode chip, e.g. "Live" or "Offline".

props.name: presence
props.description: Left, after the status: e.g. `PresenceAvatars` or `TypingIndicator`.

props.name: selectionLength
props.description: Selection length, shown as "(N selected)" after the cursor.

props.name: status
props.description: Left: usually a `SaveStatus`.

props.name: text
props.description: Document text; word/character counts, reading time and pages are derived from it.

props.name: words
props.description: Explicit word count (overrides `text`).

EditorToolbar.description:
Formatting toolbar (`role="toolbar"`) with roving tabindex (arrow keys, Home/End) and
overflow collapsing into a "More" menu when the container is too narrow.

props.name: end
props.description: Content pinned to the end that never collapses (e.g. an AI button).

props.name: moreLabel
props.description: Label of the overflow button. Default "More tools".

props.name: overflow
props.description: Collapse items that don't fit into a "More" menu. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Control size of the tools. Default "sm".

EditorToolbarButton.description: Toolbar tool: icon button with a tooltip (label + shortcut keys) and optional pressed state.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, tooltip text and overflow-menu label.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Toggle state (sets `aria-pressed`).

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keys spec for the tooltip ("mod+b").

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label next to the icon.

props.name: tooltipSide
props.description: Tooltip side. Default "bottom".

EditorToolbarMenu.description: Dropdown tool (e.g. Insert ▸ Math, Mermaid, Callout) whose items carry icon, description and shortcut.

props.name: footer
props.description: Extra content under the items (e.g. a hint).

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the label text (default true); icon-only otherwise.

EditToolBody.description: File edit body: path (link / button) and a compact DiffCard.

props.name: collapsedLines
props.description: Visible lines before the preview is capped. Default 12.

props.name: context
props.description: Unchanged lines kept around each change. Default 3.

props.name: fileStatus
props.description: new-file / deleted-file presentation. Inferred from empty old/new values when omitted.

props.name: headerExtra
props.description: Extra header content (right side, before the stat).

props.name: onOpen
props.description: When set, "Click to expand" calls this (e.g. open a full diff editor) instead of expanding inline.

props.name: onPathClick
props.description: Makes the path a button (e.g. open the file).

props.name: pathHref
props.description: Makes the path a link.

EffortGlyph.description: Ascending bars glyph: `level + 1` of `count` bars filled.

props.name: level
props.description: 0-based filled level.

props.name: count
props.description: Total levels (bars). Default 4.

EffortSlider.description: Discrete effort-level control: click or drag the bars, ← → keys, compact pill variant.

props.name: density
props.description: `"normal"` (default) shows a labelled track with a legend; `"compact"` is a small pill for the composer.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name and visible caption. Default "Effort".

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip text; `null` hides it.
props.default: "Click or drag to set effort level"

EmbedConsent.description: Privacy gate shown in place of a third-party embed until the user agrees to load it.

props.name: domain
props.description: Domain the embed loads from, shown in the notice (e.g. "youtube.com").

props.name: provider
props.description: Provider display name, e.g. "YouTube".

props.name: allowAlwaysLabel
props.description: Label of the "Always allow" menu action. Defaults to "Always allow {provider}".

props.name: children
props.description: The embed, rendered only after consent.

props.name: consented
props.description: Controlled consent for this embed.

props.name: description
props.description: Overrides the default "This will load content from … and may set cookies."

props.name: onAllowAlways
props.description:
Fired with the consent key (`providerId`) when the user picks "Always allow". For providers whose
server is user-controlled (e.g. Mastodon) RichEmbed passes an origin-scoped key, `"<id>:<origin>"`.

props.name: onConsent
props.description: Fired when the user clicks Load (or Always allow).

props.name: preview
props.description: Local preview shown inside the gate (no network).

props.name: providerId
props.description: Stable id used for remembered consent. Defaults to the lower-cased provider name.

EmbedConsentProvider.description: Remembers which embed providers the user has "always allowed". Persistence is left to the app.

props.name: allowed
props.description: Allowed provider ids (controlled). Persist them in your app (e.g. settings).

props.name: markOnly
props.description: Render only the geometric mark.

props.name: size
props.description: Height-driven size of the lockup.

EmojiPicker.description: A compact emoji picker with categories, keyword search and recently used emoji.

props.name: bare
props.description: Drop the card surface (background, border, radius, shadow), e.g. when inside a popover.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of grid columns.

props.name: quickPicks
props.description: Emoji shown as a quick-pick row above the search field.

props.name: recent
props.description: Recently used emoji (controlled).

EmojiReaction.description: A reaction pill showing an emoji and its count; highlighted when the user has reacted.

props.name: reacted
props.description: Whether the current user has reacted (controlled).

EmojiReactionBar.description: A row of reaction pills with an add-reaction button that opens an emoji picker.

props.name: onReact
props.description: Fired whenever the current user adds or removes a reaction.

props.name: presets
props.description: Quick picks shown at the top of the picker.

props.name: reactions
props.description: Reactions (controlled).

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Hide the add-reaction button.

EmptyState.description:
Placeholder for an empty list, search or first-run screen.
`variant="welcome"` is the large greeting at the start of a conversation or workspace (see `ChatEmptyState`).

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons or links under the text.

props.name: icon
props.description:
Icon shown in a ringed featured circle (default: inbox). Ignored when `illustration` is set.
In the `welcome` variant it sits in a card tile and has no default.

props.name: illustration
props.description: An `EmptyStateIllustration` variant name, or any custom node.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Optional only for the `welcome` variant.

props.name: variant
props.description: `dashed` draws a dashed bordered drop-area style box; `welcome` is the large first-run greeting (`ChatEmptyState`).

EmptyStateIllustration.description: Simple line illustrations for empty, error and success states.

props.name: size
props.description: Width in pixels (height follows the 4:3 ratio).

EnsembleBuilder.description: Mixture-of-agents preset: reference models, an aggregator and rounds, with a recursion guard.

props.name: isEnsemble
props.description: Extra check for models that resolve to an ensemble (models with `ensemble: true` are always rejected).

EntityChip.description: Inline reference to an item in any Sutra app, tinted with the app's accent.

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Hide the app icon.

props.name: preview
props.description: Hover card content (e.g. a preview of the note or task).

EpisodeCard.description: Landscape 16:9 episode card with episode number, runtime, description, progress and actions.

props.name: actions
props.description: Quiet icon actions revealed on hover (always visible on touch).

props.name: busy
props.description: Blocking overlay, e.g. `{ label: "Moving…", progress: 42 }`.

props.name: meta
props.description: Extra meta after the year, e.g. "2h 14m" or "8 episodes".

props.name: onPlay
props.description: Primary action (the whole poster is the hit target).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Thumbnail beside the text instead of above it.

props.name: progress
props.description: Watch progress 0–100 (strip along the bottom).

props.name: runtime
props.description: Seconds, or a preformatted string.

props.name: status
props.description: One status badge, top-left.

ExpandableContent.description: Height-capped container with a bottom fade and Show more / Show less.

props.name: collapsedHeight
props.description: Height (px) of the collapsed view. Default 160.

props.name: fadeClassName
props.description: Classes for the gradient (match the surface, e.g. "from-card"). Default "from-background".

ExpandCard.description:
A card that grows into its dialog: the card is the button that opens a `MorphDialog` and also the origin it flies out of and
back into. While the dialog is open the card is hidden (it comes back as the panel lands on it). The card is a native button
with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`; its content may use blocks. Controlled with `open` / `defaultOpen` / `onOpenChange`.

props.name: children
props.description: The collapsed card face. It is shown again at the top of the expanded panel (unless `repeatFace` is false), so keep it start-aligned.

props.name: detail
props.description: What the expanded panel shows below the face. A function gets `close`.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name of the expanded dialog (the visible title is in the face).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start open (uncontrolled).

props.name: description
props.description: Accessible description of the dialog.

props.name: onMorphEnd
props.description: Runs when the open or close flight has finished.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Asked to open or close: a press on the card, Escape, the close button or the scrim.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open (controlled).

props.name: panelClassName
props.description: Classes of the expanded panel.

props.name: repeatFace
props.description: Draw the face again at the top of the panel, which is what makes the morph read as one object. The copy is hidden from assistive technology and inert, so the detail must carry what the face says. Default true.

props.name: showClose
props.description: The close button at the top end of the panel. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the panel: sm, md or lg. Default "md".

props.name: variant
props.description: `"dialog"` is centred, `"sheet"` docks to the bottom edge, `"auto"` is a sheet below the `sm` breakpoint. Default "auto".

ExtensionDetailPage.description: Extension detail: breadcrumbs, hero, copyable install command, facts sidebar, capabilities, security note, screenshots, README and more from the author.

props.name: moreFromAuthor
props.description: Other extensions by the same author.

props.name: onOpenScreenshot
props.description: Called with the screenshot index; wire it to a Lightbox.

props.name: shaHref
props.description: Link for the short sha (relative path or anchor); rendered as text when omitted.

ExtensionInstallDialog.description: Install a plugin from the catalog or a git URL: source verification warning, advanced details, progress log and result.

props.name: mode
props.description: "catalog" installs a known entry; "git" asks for a URL.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called by "Done" after success.

props.name: permissions
props.description: Permissions or capabilities requested.

props.name: sha
props.description: Commit sha / digest.

props.name: source
props.description: Source URL (prefill for git mode).

props.name: verified
props.description: Source is a verified publisher.

FadeText.description: Truncates text with a soft gradient fade instead of an ellipsis; the fade only appears when the text overflows.

props.name: fade
props.description: Width (single line) or height (multi-line) of the fade, CSS length. Default "2.5rem".

props.name: lines
props.description: Clamp to this many lines (fades the last line). Default 1.

props.name: showTitle
props.description: Native tooltip with the full text when truncated (string children only). Default true.

FallbackChainEditor.description: Ordered primary + fallback models: reorder, add through the picker, remove.

props.name: caption
props.default: "Tried in order when a model fails or is rate-limited."

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum chain length.

FanControl.description:
Fan speeds with a per-fan Automatic / Fixed switch and, when Fixed, a target slider (step 100, "2,400 rpm").
Shows a note that fans return to automatic when the app quits, and a safety message when the target is below
what the system needs. Data in, events out.

props.name: accent
props.description: Default "orange".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns every control off (e.g. the privileged helper is not installed).

props.name: disabledReason
props.description: Why the controls are off, with any action ("Install Helper…"); shown above the fans when `disabled`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `fans` is empty. Default "No controllable fans".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list. Default "Fans".

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way. With no fans yet placeholder fan cards are shown (no mode switch or slider); with fans the root is only marked busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder fans while loading. Default 2.

props.name: note
props.description: Note under a fixed fan's slider. Default "Returns to automatic when the app quits"; `false` hides it.
props.default: "Returns to automatic when the app quits"

props.name: onTargetChange
props.description: Fires while the target slider moves.

props.name: onTargetCommit
props.description: Fires once when the slider is released or a key press ends; write the fan speed here.

props.name: step
props.description: Slider step in rpm. Default 100.

FanMenu.description: A hub button that fans out circular action discs along an arc (e.g. voice modes). Keyboard accessible as a menu.

props.name: icon
props.description: Hub button icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the hub button.

props.name: direction
props.description: Direction the fan opens towards. Default "up".

props.name: discSize
props.description: Disc diameter, px. Default 44.

props.name: hubSize
props.description: Hub diameter, px. Default 48.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fired with the selected item id (after the item's own `onSelect`).

props.name: radius
props.description: Distance from the hub centre to each disc, px. Default 76.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Show item labels as tooltips next to the discs. Default true.

props.name: spread
props.description: Total arc covered by the discs, degrees. Default 120.

Favicon.description: Site icon for a domain: explicit `src`, provider-resolved URL, or a local monogram.

props.name: src
props.description: Explicit icon URL; overrides the provider.

FaviconProvider.description:
Opt in to remote favicons. Without a provider, Sutra makes no network
requests and renders a local monogram tile instead.

FeaturedIcon.description: An icon presented in a tinted tile, with soft, solid, ring-halo and glass styles.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component to render inside the tile. Alternatively pass the icon as children.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label; decorative when omitted.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour. Default `primary`.

FeatureGrid.description: Icon + title + description cards in a 2–4 column grid, with an optional section header.

FeedbackDialog.description: Collect a star rating, a category and a written message; shows a thank-you state.

props.name: categories
props.default: [ { value: "idea", label: "Idea" }, { value: "bug", label: "Bug" }, { value: "praise", label: "Praise" }, { value: "other", label: "Other" }, ]

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`).

Field.description: Groups a label, control, description and error, and wires their ids together.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the control. Generated when omitted.

FieldContent.description: Stacks label, description and error next to a control in a horizontal field.

FieldError.description: Validation message, announced to assistive tech. Renders nothing when empty.

props.name: errors
props.description: Error objects or strings (e.g. from a form library). Used when no children are given.

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Hide the leading icon.

FieldGroup.description: Vertical stack of fields with consistent spacing.

FieldHint.description: Small secondary hint, typically placed under the control.

props.name: icon
props.description: Show a leading info icon, or pass a custom icon.

FieldLabel.description: Label bound to the field's control.

props.name: hint
props.description: Muted helper shown after the label text, e.g. "(optional)".

props.name: variant
props.description: `legend` renders a section title, `label` matches a field label.

Fieldset.description: Native fieldset for grouping related fields under a legend.

FileFormatIcon.description: A document icon with a folded corner and a colored file-extension label.

props.name: ext
props.description: Extension or filename (e.g. `"pdf"` or `"Q3 report.pdf"`).

props.name: color
props.description: Override the format color.

props.name: label
props.description: Override the label text (defaults to the uppercased extension).

props.name: size
props.description: Size token or height in pixels.

props.name: variant
props.description: `default` white sheet with a colored label, `solid` colored sheet, `minimal` outline with colored text.

FilePreviewCard.description: Thumbnail tile for a file: image preview or format icon, name and size. Click to open a viewer.

props.name: meta
props.description: Extra line under the name (defaults to the formatted size).

FileUpload.description: Compound file uploader root: owns file state, validation and the hidden input.

props.name: files
props.description: Controlled list of files.

props.name: onFilesAdded
props.description: Called with newly added files only — a good place to start uploads.

props.name: showErrors
props.description: Render validation errors under the children.

FileUploadDropzone.description: `Dropzone` wired to the surrounding `FileUpload` state and limits.

props.name: density
props.description: `compact` is a single-row layout for tight spaces. Default `normal`.

props.name: directory
props.description:
Upload whole folders: clicking opens a folder picker (`webkitdirectory`) and dropped folders are
walked recursively. Every file is validated on its own and carries its `relativePath`
(see `getFileRelativePath`). Where the browser can't pick folders, clicking falls back to the file
picker and the hint says why.

props.name: hint
props.description: Defaults to a description of `accept` / `maxSize`.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for the underlying file input.

FileUploadItem.description: A single file row: type badge, name, size, progress and status.

props.name: hideRemove
props.description: Hide the remove button.

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Overrides the default remove behaviour (removing from `FileUpload` state).

FileUploadList.description: List of selected files. Renders a `FileUploadItem` per file when no children are given.

FileUploadTrigger.description: Button that opens the file picker (or, with `directory`, a folder picker).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: directory
props.description:
Open a folder picker instead of the file picker: every file inside is validated on its own and keeps
its `relativePath` (see `getFileRelativePath`). Where the browser can't pick folders the button stays
focusable but inert (`aria-disabled`) and describes why; set `hideWhenUnsupported` to drop it instead.
Pair it with a plain trigger for "Upload files" / "Upload folder".

props.name: hideWhenUnsupported
props.description: With `directory`, render nothing where folder picking is unsupported (instead of an inert button).

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

FileViewer.description:
Previews a file by type (image, PDF, video, audio, text/code/markdown/JSON) in a modal or inline. Apps can add their
own renderers, browse several `files`, put actions in the header and show a side panel.

props.name: actions
props.description: App actions in the header (share, rename, delete …), before the built-in download and close actions.

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Initial position in `files` (uncontrolled). Default 0.

props.name: defaultPanelOpen
props.description: Default true.

props.name: download
props.description: Show the header download action. Default true when the file has a URL.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `files` is empty and nothing is loading.

props.name: file
props.description: The file to show. In a gallery, pass `files` instead.

props.name: files
props.description: Files to browse with previous/next buttons, ←/→ and an optional thumbnail strip. Takes precedence over `file`.

props.name: index
props.description: Position in `files` (controlled).

props.name: inline
props.description: Render in place instead of in a modal.

props.name: kind
props.description: Override the detected renderer.

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the file (or its URL). Shows skeletons until there is something to show.

props.name: loadText
props.description: Load text content (default: `file.blob`, then `fetch(file.url)`).

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap from the last file to the first and back. Default false.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Close action for inline viewers (modal viewers close via `onOpenChange`).

props.name: openInNewTab
props.description: Show the "open in new tab" action. Default true when the file has a URL.

props.name: panel
props.description: Side panel (details, metadata, comments). Sits beside the content on wide viewers and below it on narrow ones.

props.name: panelLabel
props.description: Name of the side panel and its header toggle. Default "Details".

props.name: renderers
props.description: App renderers, tried in order before the built-in kinds.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Line under the title (default: the formatted size).

props.name: text
props.description: Text content for text/code/markdown/json files (single `file` only; in a gallery set each file's `text`).

props.name: thumbnails
props.description: Show a thumbnail strip under the content when browsing several files. Default false.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title (default: the file name). Also the dialog's accessible name.

FilterBar.description: Toolbar row for lists and tables: search, filter chips and actions.

FilterBarActive.description: Row of applied filter tokens. Pass `filters` or `FilterBarToken` children.

FilterBarChip.description: Dashed "+ Filter" button that opens a multi-select checklist.

props.name: maxDisplay
props.description: How many selected values to list before collapsing to "N selected".

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a search input inside the popover. Defaults to true when there are more than 7 options.

FilterBarClear.description: "Clear all" text button for resetting filters.

FilterBarSearch.description: Compact search input with a clear button.

FilterPill.deprecated: Use `FilterBarChip` (the dashed "+ Filter" button; it is not a pill).

props.name: maxDisplay
props.description: How many selected values to list before collapsing to "N selected".

props.name: searchable
props.description: Show a search input inside the popover. Defaults to true when there are more than 7 options.

FloatingActionButton.description: Floating primary action, optionally expanding into a speed-dial menu.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; also the visible text when `extended`.

props.name: actions
props.description: Speed-dial actions that fan out on click.

props.name: extended
props.description: Show the label next to the icon.

props.name: strategy
props.description: `fixed` to the viewport (default), `absolute` within a relative parent, or `static` inline.

FloatingPanes.description: Layer of draggable, resizable floating windows kept inside their container.

props.name: panes
props.description: Windows; the last one is in front.

props.name: onDock
props.description: Show a "dock" button that hands the pane back to the layout.

props.name: paneLabel
props.description: Plain-text name for labels (defaults to a string title or the id).

FocusViewItem.description: Renders its children unless focus view hides this kind of row.

FocusViewProvider.description: Shares the focus-view state between a `FocusViewToggle` and transcript rows.

props.name: hiddenKinds
props.description: Kinds hidden while focused. Default `["tool"]`.

FocusViewToggle.description: Toggle that hides tool calls and keeps only user/assistant rows (reads `FocusViewProvider`).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Default "Focus". Set `iconOnly` to hide it.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Used only outside a `FocusViewProvider`.

ForgotPasswordCard.description: Request a password reset link; shows a confirmation once sent.

props.name: description
props.default: "No worries. Enter your email and we'll send you reset instructions."

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

Frame.description: A titled tray around a panel of rows: `FrameHeader` (title, description, action), `FramePanel`, `FrameFooter`.

FrameAction.description: A control on the right of the header (a button, a link, a menu).

FrameDescription.description: A line of explanation under or beside the title.

FrameFooter.description: The bottom of a frame: a count, a hint or an action.

FrameHeader.description: The top of a frame: title and description on the left, an action on the right; wraps when narrow.

FramePanel.description: The raised surface that holds the rows. Rows are its direct children; a list of `Item`s works as is.

props.name: divided
props.description: Draw hairlines between the rows. Default true.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no children (and not loading).

props.name: loading
props.description: Show placeholder rows while the rows are not known yet.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Number of placeholder rows. Default 3.

props.name: as
props.description: The heading element. Default `h3`.

FrequencyMeter.description: Three-bar "how common is this word" indicator.

props.name: level
props.description: 0 (rare) … 3 (very common).

FunnelChart.description: Funnel chart: stage names and values at the left, the narrowing shape at the right, keyboard and tooltip readouts.

props.name: data
props.description: One row per stage, in funnel order (the chart does not sort).

props.name: animate
props.description: CSS transitions on data changes (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion). Default true.

props.name: color
props.description: One color for every stage; stages shade from full strength at the top to lighter at the bottom. Default the first chart color.

props.name: colors
props.description: A color per stage instead (no shading).

props.name: connected
props.description: Stages join with sloping sides (default) or are separate centered bars (`false`).

props.name: conversion
props.description:
The conversion rate shown beside each stage (after the first): `"previous"` is the share of the stage before
(default), `"first"` the share of the top stage, `false` hides rates. The tooltip and the table always list both.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px. Default 44px per stage (at least 120).

props.name: index
props.description: Key of the stage name. Default "label".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to a description built from the stages.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no data, a placeholder funnel of the same size; with data, the root is marked busy.

props.name: valueKey
props.description: Key of the stage value. Default "value".

GatewayStatusPopover.description: Status-bar gateway indicator with a popover of uptime, version, controls and a live log tail.

props.name: error
props.description: Error detail shown when state is "error".

props.name: logLines
props.description: Recent log lines rendered in the tail panel.

props.name: logSlot
props.description: Custom log tail content (e.g. a streaming LogViewer); replaces `logLines`.

props.name: name
props.description: Gateway display name. Default "Gateway".

props.name: uptime
props.description: Seconds (formatted) or a preformatted string.

Gauge.description: Radial arc gauge with threshold coloring (role="meter").

props.name: accent
props.description:
Categorical arc colour (a sensor or metric colour). Colour order: `colorStops`, then the warning/danger threshold
colours, then `tone`/`color`, then `accent`, then primary. Sets `--sutra-accent` on the root.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content under the value (replaces the label slot).

props.name: colorStops
props.description: Custom colors by absolute value (overrides thresholds).

props.name: endAngle
props.description: Arc end in degrees. Default 135 (270° sweep).

props.name: glow
props.description: Soft colored glow around the value arc.

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the first reading: with `value` null, the track stays empty and a placeholder stands in for the number.

props.name: max
props.description: Default 100.

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Arc start in degrees (0 = top, clockwise). Default -135.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Stroke width override in px.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Percent thresholds, same semantics as Meter.

props.name: tone
props.description: Base tone below thresholds. Default `primary`.

GeoMarkerLayer.description:
HTML overlay of marker buttons positioned over a map drawing: focusable, labelled, `aria-pressed` for the
selected one, optional clustering into count bubbles and a hover/focus tooltip. Shared by WorldMap and the globe.

props.name: project
props.description: Screen position of a point, or `null` to hide the marker (clipped, or on a globe's far side).

props.name: width
props.description: Size of the drawing the layer sits on, used to keep tooltips inside.

props.name: activeId
props.description: A marker to show as active from outside (tooltip and ring), e.g. while a list row for it has focus.

props.name: cluster
props.description: Merge nearby markers into count bubbles. The selected marker always stays on its own.

props.name: compact
props.description:
Smaller markers (about 70%) and a wider default cluster radius, for small maps where avatars would crowd.
Default: on when `width` is under 480 px.

props.name: markerOpacity
props.description: Opacity per marker, 0–1 (the globe fades markers near its edge). Markers at 0 are not rendered.

props.name: onClusterSelect
props.description: Called when a cluster bubble is activated.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.type: (id: string | null, marker: GeoMarker | undefined) => void
props.description: Called with the new selection (`null` when the selected marker is activated again).

props.name: sizeRange
props.description: Diameter range in px for `value`-scaled markers. Default `[8, 28]`.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show a tooltip for the hovered or focused marker. Default true.

GitStatusLetter.description: Colored status letter with a screen-reader label.

props.name: status
props.description: Default `modified`.

Globe.description:
Interactive 3D globe (orthographic, bundled outlines): drag with momentum, wheel/pinch/keyboard zoom, auto-rotation,
fly-to, and the same choropleth, markers, clustering, arcs, country selection and screen-reader tables as WorldMap.

props.name: apiRef
props.description: Imperative handle (`flyTo`, `reset`, `zoomIn`, `zoomOut`, `getView`); `ref` stays on the root element.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description:
Spin slowly: `true` for 8°/s or a speed in degrees per second (negative turns westward). Pauses while the user
drags, zooms, hovers or focuses a marker, or has one selected, and resumes after `autoRotateDelay`. Starts off
under reduced motion (the play control can still start it) and stops while off-screen or in a hidden tab.

props.name: autoRotateDelay
props.description: Ms of quiet before auto-rotation resumes. Default 2500.

props.name: cluster
props.description: Merge nearby markers into count bubbles (`{ radius }` in px, default 36; 48 for compact markers).

props.name: color
props.description: Colour token or any CSS colour for the choropleth. Default `primary`.

props.name: compactMarkers
props.description: Smaller markers and a wider cluster radius. Default: on when the drawing is narrower than 480 px.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the play/pause, zoom and reset buttons. Default false.

props.name: controlsClassName
props.description: Classes for the control bar (bottom-end by default).

props.name: data
props.description: Choropleth values by country.

props.name: dataTable
props.description:
Render the visually hidden screen-reader tables (countries, markers, arcs). Default true. Set false when the page
already lists the same data accessibly next to the map (as LiveVisitorsMap, SignInMap and RegionStatusMap do).

props.name: defaultRotation
props.description: Starting rotation. Defaults to centring `focus`, else the selected marker, else Europe and Africa.

props.name: defaultWidth
props.description: Width used before the container is measured (and in jsdom). Default 480.

props.name: domain
props.description: Value range for `quantize`. Defaults to the data's min and max.

props.name: flyToSelection
props.description: Fly to a marker when it is selected. Default true.

props.name: focus
props.description: A point to turn to: the globe flies there whenever this changes (and starts there).

props.name: graticule
props.description: Draw 10° graticule lines.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px. Default: the measured width (a square).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; defaults to a summary ("World map: 12 countries with data, 16 markers"). `aria-label` also works.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the stepped scale legend under the map.

props.name: loading

props.name: onRotationChange

pauses; not on every frame, so a parent that stores the value doesn't re-render 60 times a second.

props.name: onZoomChange
props.description: Called with the resting zoom (see `onRotationChange`).

props.name: padding
props.description: Space between the globe and the edge in px. Default 8.

props.name: rotation
props.description:
Rotation `[λ, φ, γ]` in degrees (`rotationToCenter(point)` builds one). The globe jumps to it whenever it changes;
drags and animations move the globe on their own and report the resting rotation to `onRotationChange`.

props.name: scale
props.description: Bucketing: `quantize` (equal ranges, default) or `quantile` (equal counts).

props.name: selectedCountry
props.description: Highlighted country (alpha-2 code). Clicking a country selects it when this, `defaultSelectedCountry` or `onCountrySelect` is set.

props.name: shading

props.name: steps

props.name: tooltip

props.name: valueLabel

props.name: wheelZoom
props.description: Zoom with the mouse wheel or trackpad pinch. Default true.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Zoom as a scale multiplier (1 = the whole globe fits). Same jump-and-report contract as `rotation`.

props.name: paused

HardwareFitHint.description: Badge + explanation of how a model fits the given hardware.

HeaderNavActions.description: Right-aligned actions (sign in, CTA, theme toggle).

HeatByApp.description: `BarList` preset ranking apps by energy impact (the heat they add), with a short explanation underneath.

HeatmapGrid.description: Generic value → color cell grid (per-core CPU, per-GPU load, matrices) with keyboard navigation.

props.description: Accessible name of the grid.

HeroHeader.description: Marketing hero: eyebrow pill, display heading, subtext, CTAs on a mesh gradient.

props.name: description

HoverCard.description: Hover card root (preview on hover, e.g. user cards and link previews).

Icon.description: Sized, toned wrapper around any icon component.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label. When omitted the icon is decorative (`aria-hidden`).

IdentityMark.description: Procedural identity glyph: a dial of twelve ticks, five lit by a hash of the seed.

props.name: seed
props.description: Identity string (person, machine or app id). The same seed always draws the same mark.

props.name: color
props.description: `hash` picks a color from the seed, `current` uses currentColor, or pass any CSS color.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hide from assistive tech (when the name is already next to it).

props.name: picture
props.description:
Image URL (a photo or app icon) drawn inside the core shape, with the tick dial and outline kept as
its frame. The generated mark shows while it loads and stays if the image fails or the URL is unsafe
(http(s), relative, `blob:` and `data:image/` are allowed). The mark's `label` is its accessible name.

props.name: state
props.description: Adds an outer ring: pulsing green for live, amber for busy, dashed grey for offline.

ImageCropper.description: Image crop box: drag to move, eight handles to resize, aspect presets, quarter-turn rotation and optional zoom.

IncomingCall.description: Ringing incoming call card with pulsing avatar rings and Accept / Decline / Message actions.

from assistive tech, declines on Escape and returns focus when it unmounts.

InfoTooltip.description: Small (i) / (?) icon button that reveals a title + description tooltip.

props.description: Body text.

props.description: Accessible label for the trigger.

props.name: title
props.description: Bold first line.

Contextual message placed inline with content (forms, panels, settings).

Single-line inline editor for renaming things in place: Enter or blur commits, Escape cancels,

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every keystroke with the raw draft.

props.name: value
props.description: Draft text (controlled).

Input.description: Text input with optional icons, text addons and a clear button. Consumes `Field` context.

props.name: className
props.description:
Classes for the element that renders. Without addons that is the `<input>` itself (the root).
With addons (`leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `clearable`) it lands on the
**inner** `<input>`, not the outer wrapper, so layout classes (`w-48`, `flex-1`, margins) have no
visible effect there; use `wrapperClassName` for those.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button while the field has a value.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered inside the field before the text.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text addon before the field, e.g. "https://".

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text addon after the field, e.g. ".com".

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon or small action rendered inside the field after the text.

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description:
Classes for the outer wrapper `<div>`, which is only rendered when addons are present. Put
layout/sizing classes here when the input has addons.

InputGroup.description: A container that looks like a single input and hosts addons around a control.

LineChart.description: Multi-series line chart with optional dots and reference (threshold) lines.

Magnetic.description:
Makes its child drift toward the mouse when the pointer comes within `radius` of it (the `magnetic` utility). The
wrapper stays put and measures; an inner box moves, so the hit area and the layout do not shift. Clicks, hover and
focus work as without it. Wrap a button, a link or an icon; not a text field. Touch and reduced motion: still.

props.name: radius
props.description: How far past its edge the pointer starts to pull, in px. Default 80.

props.name: strength
props.description: How much of the pointer's offset it follows, 0..1. Default 0.35 (paper scales it down).

Markdown.description: Token-styled markdown renderer (GFM), memoized per block so streaming only re-renders the tail.

props.name: children
props.description: Markdown source.

props.name: citeCount
props.description:
Number of citable sources: bracketed refs like `[1]` or `[2,3]` in prose (not code or links)
render as citation pills. Defaults to `sources.length` when `sources` is given.

props.name: components
props.description: Override or extend the element renderers. Keep the object stable (module scope or useMemo).

props.name: math
props.description:
Render TeX math with KaTeX: inline `$…$` and display `$$…$$`. Default false.
Consumers must also load the KaTeX stylesheet once: `import "katex/dist/katex.min.css";`

props.name: onCite
props.description: Called with the 1-based source number when a citation pill is clicked (pills render as buttons).

props.name: remarkPlugins
props.description: Extra remark plugins (GFM is always on). Keep the array stable.

props.name: sources
props.description: Sources for citation pills; `sources[n-1]` supplies the title (and href/snippet hover card).

Marquee.description:
An endless, slowly scrolling row of items (logos, chips, quotes). The row repeats its items as often as the width needs,
hides the repeats from assistive tech and stands still, wrapped onto lines, under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Keep the items presentational: the repeats are inert, so links and buttons inside would not work in them.

props.name: children
props.description: The items. Each child becomes one list item; the whole set is repeated to make the loop seamless.

props.name: defaultPaused
props.description: Initial paused state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one loop. Default 30.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the left and right edges out. Default true.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items: a number is pixels, a string is any CSS length. Default `3rem`.

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Classes for every item's `li`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: Called with the new state when the button is pressed.

props.name: pausable
props.description:
Show a pause and play button at the end of the row, in the flow beside the track (WCAG 2.2.2: moving content
needs a control that outlasts hover and focus, for touch and keyboard users). Hidden under reduced motion, where
the row is already still. Default false.

props.name: paused
props.description: Controlled paused state. The button toggles it; `pauseOnHover` still pauses on top of it.

props.name: pauseLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the pause button (a toggle: it stays the same while `aria-pressed` flips). Default "Pause scrolling".

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Stop scrolling while the pointer or keyboard focus is inside. Default true.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Scroll left to right instead of right to left.
