MorphDialog.description:
A dialog (or bottom sheet) that grows out of the rectangle of the thing that opened it and shrinks back into it. The panel is
clipped to the origin's box and its radius and slides onto its final place (Web Animations on the spring token, nothing is
scaled, so text never stretches); the scrim, the shadow and the parts marked `data-morph-fade` appear late and go early.
It is a Radix Dialog underneath: focus is trapped and handed back on close (to the `trigger`, or to whatever had it), Escape,
the close button and a press on the scrim close it, and the panel stays mounted until the closing flight ends. Reduced motion
(or no `animate`) means no flight at all. Pass `origin` (an element, a ref or a rect), or use `ExpandCard` for a card that is
its own origin. Start the panel's content with the same face as the origin and the flight reads as one object.

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible name of the dialog.

props.name: children
props.description: The panel content. Parts marked `data-morph-fade` appear late and go early.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes of the panel.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start open (uncontrolled).

props.name: description
props.description: Accessible description.

props.name: onCloseAutoFocus
props.description: Runs when focus is handed back; `preventDefault()` keeps the default (the trigger, or whatever had focus).

props.name: onMorphEnd
props.description: Runs when the open or close flight has finished (at once under reduced motion).

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description: Runs when focus moves into the panel; `preventDefault()` keeps Radix from choosing the element.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Asked to open or close: Escape, the close button, a press on the scrim or the trigger.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is open (controlled).

props.name: origin
props.description: The box the panel grows from and shrinks back into. It is measured when the dialog opens and again when it closes. Without one the panel lifts in.

props.name: overlayClassName
props.description: Classes of the scrim.

props.name: showClose
props.description: The close button at the top end of the panel. Default true.

props.name: showTitle
props.description: Show the title as a heading at the top of the panel instead of hiding it from sight. Default false.

props.name: size
props.description: Width of the panel: sm, md or lg. Default "md".

props.name: trigger
props.description: The element that opens it (rendered with `asChild`); it gets focus back on close.

props.name: variant
props.description: `"dialog"` is centred, `"sheet"` docks to the bottom edge, `"auto"` is a sheet below the `sm` breakpoint. Default "auto".

MorphPill.description:
One surface that changes size between states (idle, a picker, a running timer, a sync status): its width and height
follow the measured content on a spring token, and the new content fades in as the old one goes. Under reduced
motion the size and the content swap at once (the shared net). Controlled (`state`) or uncontrolled (`defaultState`);
pass a function as a state's content to switch states from inside. It is an inline surface: put it in a container
with room (`max-w-full` keeps it inside a narrow one, and its content is clipped, not overflowing).

props.name: states
props.description: The content of each state; a function receives the current state and `setState`, for buttons inside the pill.

props.name: announcement
props.description: Text for a polite live region that screen readers hear when the state changes (the pill itself is silent).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; makes the pill a `role="group"`.

props.name: spring
props.description: Which spring token the size change rides. Default "snappy".

PanSurface.description:
An inertial canvas for boards and big images: drag it and it keeps gliding with time-based friction (`usePan`), stops at its
edges with a springy bounce, and moves with the wheel and the arrow keys (Shift for bigger steps, Page Up and Down, Home to
recenter). With `zoom` the existing `useZoomPan` handles the scale (wheel with Ctrl or Command, buttons, `+`, `-`, `0`);
the offset stays in `usePan`'s CSS variables, so a drag never re-renders. A recenter button appears once the canvas has
moved. It is a labelled, focusable group whose content stays in the DOM order for screen readers. A drag on a button inside
the canvas still pans and the click after a drag is swallowed; put `data-pan-ignore` on parts that need their own pointer
handling. The surface takes touch from the page (`touch-action: none` on its axis), so leave room to scroll around it.

props.name: children
props.description: The canvas: a board, a big image, a diagram. It is centred and keeps its own size.

props.name: apiRef
props.description: Imperative handle (`recenter`, `panTo`, `panBy`, `get`).

props.name: axis
props.description: Axis that follows the finger; the other is left to native scrolling. Default "both".

props.name: bounds
props.description: `"content"` stops the canvas where its edge meets the viewport (a canvas that fits cannot move); `"none"` lets it go anywhere. Default "content".

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes of the layer that moves (padding around the canvas goes here).

props.name: contentSize
props.description: Natural size of the canvas when it is known (otherwise measured).

props.name: controls
props.description: The control buttons: `"auto"` shows them once the canvas has moved or zoomed, `true` always, `false` never. Default "auto".

props.name: defaultScale
props.description: The zoom at rest and after Recenter. Default 1.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignore drags, the wheel and keys (and drop the tab stop).

props.name: friction
props.description: Friction per second of the glide after a flick. Default 6.

props.name: home
props.description: Where the canvas rests and where Recenter and Home bring it: `"center"`, or `"start"` to line its inline-start and top edges up with the viewport's (a board begins at its first column; right-to-left text starts at the right). Default "center".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the surface. Default "Pannable canvas".

props.name: maxScale
props.description: Largest zoom. Default 4.

props.name: minScale
props.description: Smallest zoom. Default 0.5.

props.name: onPan
props.description: Runs whenever the offset changes (every frame of a drag or glide).

props.name: recenterLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the recenter button. Default "Recenter".

props.name: spring
props.description: Spring of the bounce and of the recenter glide. Default "gentle".

props.name: step
props.description: Px of one arrow key press (four times that with Shift). Default 48.

props.name: wheel
props.description: `"pan"`: the wheel moves the canvas (and is left to the page at the edge); `"none"`. Default "pan".

props.name: zoom
props.description: Add zoom, composed from `useZoomPan`: Ctrl or Command with the wheel (a trackpad pinch), the buttons and the `+`, `-`, `0` keys. Default false.

props.description:
A `Worker` already running pdf.js's worker script, e.g.
`new Worker(new URL("pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs", import.meta.url), { type: "module" })`.
Shared by every document opened with it. Takes precedence over `workerSrc`.

With neither option and no global `GlobalWorkerOptions` set, pdf.js runs on the main thread (its "fake worker"):
it works, but parsing large files blocks the page.

props.name: workerSrc

URL of pdf.js's **legacy** worker script, from your bundler. With Vite:
`import workerSrc from "pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs?url"`. Sets the global
`GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc`. The modern `pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs` works too, but only in the
newest browsers; where it fails on a missing built-in the viewer warns once and parses in the page instead.
Serve it from the page's origin under a strict CSP (a cross-origin worker needs `worker-src blob:`).

Presence.description:
Mounts a child when `present` turns true and unmounts it after its exit animation when it turns false. The child carries `data-state="open" | "closed"` and `data-presence="enter" | "idle" | "exit"`, so plain classes do the motion:
...
 An exiting child is `inert` and `aria-hidden` (out of the tab order and the accessibility tree at once, still painted) and is removed on its own `animationend` / `transitionend`, or after `exitDuration`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` it mounts and unmounts at once, with no enter or exit state. For a list use `AnimatedList`; Radix overlays already do this.

props.name: children
props.description: One element that accepts DOM props (it gets `data-state`, `data-presence`, `inert` and the animation listeners).

props.name: present
props.description: Whether the child should be on screen. Going to false keeps it mounted until its exit animation has ended.

props.name: exitDuration
props.description: Milliseconds before an exiting child is removed even if no `animationend` or `transitionend` arrived. Default 200, the speed of `animate-fade-out`.

props.name: initial
props.description: Animate the child in when it is present on the first render too. Default false.

props.name: onExited
props.description: Called once the child has been removed.

QuotaBars.description:
Compact row of provider icons with thin accent bars, as in a dashboard's Agents tile. Each bar is a meter named after
the provider with value text such as "72% left".

The Agents tile is a `StatCard` with this row as its body:
```tsx
<StatCard label="Agents" icon={<RiRobot2Line />} accent="violet" href="/agents"
  caption="Claude · Max 20x · This week" value="72%" unit="left"
  stats={[{ label: "Resets", value: formatResetsIn(claude.resetsAt) }, { label: "Sessions", value: 2 },
          { label: "Tokens today", value: formatTokens(1_780_000) }]}>
  <QuotaBars quotas={quotas} />
</StatCard>
```

props.name: loading

props.description: Placeholder bars while loading with no quotas. Default 3.

props.description: What each bar shows. Default "left".

props.description: Provider mark, shown before the name (decorative). Falls back to a monogram in `QuotaBars`.

props.name: limit
props.description: Size of the quota. Default 100 (so `used` is a percentage).

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the first reading: with no `used`/`percent` the ring is an empty track and the status line a placeholder.

props.name: mode
props.description: What the ring and the number show. Default "left".

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for the pace and reset text. Default `Date.now()` at render.

props.name: pace
props.description: Set false to show the reset time instead of the pace. Default true.

props.name: percent
props.description: Percent of the limit used, 0–100 (the `UsageLimitWindow` field); read when `used` is not set.

props.name: resetLabel
props.description: Overrides the computed reset caption shown when there is no pace.

props.name: size
props.description: Ring diameter: sm 44, md 56 (default), lg 72.

props.name: startsAt
props.description: Window start; enables the pace line ("On pace · 10% to spare").

props.name: tolerance
props.description: "On pace" band in percentage points. Default 5.

props.name: used
props.description: Usage so far in units of `limit`. Wins over `percent`.

QuotaStrip.description: Row of provider quota rings: one column on phones, two on small screens, four on wide ones.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `quotas` is empty. Default "No quotas".

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the quotas: with none yet, `loadingRows` placeholder rings stand in (rings without a reading show placeholders too).

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder rings while loading with no quotas. Default 4.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` (default): a padded card surface · `plain`: no surface.

RadarChart.description: Radar (spider) chart: polygon rings, labelled spokes, toggleable series, spoke-by-spoke keyboard and a tooltip per spoke.

props.name: data
props.description: One row per spoke (a measure), with a value for each series.

props.name: index
props.description: Key of the spoke name in each datum.

props.name: series
props.description: One polygon per series.

props.name: animate
props.description: CSS transitions on data changes (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion). Default true.

props.name: domain
props.description:
Value range from the center to the rim: `[min, max]`, either end may be `"auto"` (fit the data). Default: from
0 (or the lowest value, when negative) up to a round number above the highest.

props.name: dots
props.description: Mark each value on its spoke. Default true.

props.name: fill
props.description: Tint the inside of each polygon. Default true.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px (legend excluded). Default 320.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to a description built from the series.

props.name: legend
props.description: Default: shown below for 2+ series.

props.name: legendInteractive
props.description: Allow toggling/isolating series from the legend. Default true.

props.name: levelLabels
props.description: Print the ring values between the first two spokes. Default true.

props.name: levels
props.description: Approximate number of grid rings. Default 4.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no data, a placeholder radar (and legend) of the same size; with data, the root is marked busy.

props.name: onActiveIndexChange
props.description: The spoke under the pointer or keyboard focus (index in `data`), or null.

props.name: shape
props.description: Grid rings as polygons (default) or circles. Fewer than three spokes always use circles.

RadioCard.description: Bordered, selectable card variant of a radio item.

props.name: radioClassName
props.description: Class for the radio control (`className` styles the card).

RadioField.description: Radio item with a label and optional description.

RadioGroup.description: Single-choice group of radio items. Consumes `Field` context.

RadioGroupField.description: Data-driven radio group with a label, description and an `options` array.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders each option as a `RadioCard`.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Class for the outer wrapper.

RadioGroupItem.description: A radio button with a springy dot indicator.

RangeSlider.description: `Slider` preset with two thumbs (defaults to the full min–max range).

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the range, thumb border and active marks. Default primary.

props.name: getValueText
props.description: Accessible value text per thumb (`aria-valuetext`), e.g. `(v) => v + "%"`.

props.name: marks
props.description: Tick marks under the track; numbers or `{ value, label }`.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show a value bubble above the thumb on hover, focus and drag. `"always"` keeps it visible.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible labels per thumb, e.g. `["Minimum", "Maximum"]`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour (`success`, `warning`, …). Takes precedence over `accent`.

Rating.description: Star rating input with hover preview, half steps and radiogroup keyboard support.

props.name: activeClassName
props.description: Class applied to the filled part of each icon (defaults to an amber fill).

props.name: allowClear
props.description:
Let the user take the rating back to 0: click the selected star again, press Delete, Backspace or 0, or arrow
below the first step. `false` keeps a given rating at one star or more. Default true.

props.name: allowHalf
props.description: Allow half-star values (0.5 steps).

props.name: getLabel
props.description: Builds the accessible label for each option.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component used for every star; receives `className`.

props.name: inactiveClassName
props.description: Class applied to the empty part of each icon.

props.name: max
props.description: Number of stars.

props.name: name
props.description: Name for a hidden input, for native form submission.

RatingSummary.description: Review summary: average score, stars, count and a 5→1 distribution chart.

props.name: average
props.description: Average score, e.g. 4.3.

props.name: count
props.description: Total number of ratings. Defaults to the sum of `distribution`.

props.name: countLabel
props.description: Text after the count.

props.name: distribution
props.description: Ratings per star, keyed by star value: `{ 5: 120, 4: 40, … }`.

ReadToolBody.description: File read body: path, line range and an optional snippet.

props.name: snippet
props.description: Excerpt of what was read.

RealProfileConsentDialog.description: Asks before letting the agent use the user's real browser profile (cookies, logins) instead of a clean one.

props.name: defaultRemember
props.description: Default state of "Remember my choice".

props.name: onChoose
props.description: Called with the choice and whether to remember it. Closes the dialog.

props.name: profileName
props.description: e.g. "Chrome — Personal".

props.name: site
props.description: Site the agent wants to open, shown in the copy.

ReasoningPill.description: Composer pill summarizing thinking / fast / effort, with a popover of toggles and an EffortSlider.

props.name: supportsThinking
props.description: Hide controls the current model doesn't support.

RecoveryKey.description: Recovery key panel: grouped mono grid, copy/download/share/print, auto-clear countdown and a confirm-saved step.

props.name: value
props.description: The raw key (separators are ignored).

props.name: autoClearAfter
props.description: Hide the key after this many ms (0 disables). Default 60000.

props.name: columns
props.description: Grid columns for the groups. Default 4.

props.name: confirm
props.description: Ask the user to type the last 4 characters before finishing. Default true.

props.name: fileContent
props.description: File body. Defaults to a short header plus the grouped key.

props.name: fileName
props.description: Download file name; `false` hides the button.

props.name: onConfirmed
props.description: Called after the confirm step succeeds (or on "I've saved it" when `confirm` is false).

props.name: onHide
props.description: Fired when the key is hidden (timer or "Hide now").

props.name: onPrint
props.description: Override printing.

props.name: printable
props.description: Show a Print button. Default true.

props.name: share
props.description: Show a Share button when the Web Share API is available.

RecoveryKeyInput.description: Recovery key entry with auto-grouping, uppercase normalization and validation.

props.name: alphabet
props.description: Allowed characters (tested per uppercased char).

props.name: className
props.description:
Classes for the element that renders. Without addons that is the `<input>` itself (the root).
With addons (`leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `clearable`) it lands on the
**inner** `<input>`, not the outer wrapper, so layout classes (`w-48`, `flex-1`, margins) have no
visible effect there; use `wrapperClassName` for those.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button while the field has a value.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered inside the field before the text.

props.name: length
props.description: Expected number of characters. Default 24.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once the key reaches `length` and passes `validate`.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text addon before the field, e.g. "https://".

props.name: showStatus
props.description: Show the "n / length" counter and validity hint. Default true.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text addon after the field, e.g. ".com".

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon or small action rendered inside the field after the text.

props.name: validate
props.description: Return true or an error message.

props.name: value
props.description: Normalized key (no separators).

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description:
Classes for the outer wrapper `<div>`, which is only rendered when addons are present. Put
layout/sizing classes here when the input has addons.

RecurrencePicker.description: Repeat-rule editor: none / daily / weekly (weekday toggles) / monthly / yearly / custom interval, plus an end condition.

props.name: referenceDate
props.description: Reference date used for sensible defaults (weekday, day of month). Default today.

props.name: showSummary
props.description: Show the human-readable summary under the controls. Default true.

RegionStatusMap.description:
Infrastructure regions on a world map or globe: markers toned by status and sized by load, replication/traffic
links as arcs, a status legend with counts, a sortable region table whose rows select the marker, and a detail
panel (status, incident, load meter, latency and node readings, links, actions) for the selected region.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Spin the globe view slowly (see `Globe`'s `autoRotate`).

props.name: cluster
props.description: Merge nearby markers into count bubbles. Default false.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown instead of the map and table when there are no regions.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the map. Defaults to a summary ("Region map: 12 regions, 1 down, 2 degraded").

props.name: latencyThresholds
props.description: Latency (ms) at which readings turn warning / destructive. Default `{ warning: 150, danger: 300 }`.

props.name: links
props.description: Replication or traffic links between regions, drawn as arcs toned by health.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: skeletons with no regions yet; otherwise the current regions stay and the root is busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Skeleton rows in the table while loading. Default 5.

props.name: loadThresholds
props.description: Load percent at which meters turn warning / destructive. Default `{ warn: 75, danger: 90 }`.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for numbers.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.type: (id: string | null, region: StatusRegion | undefined) => void

props.name: renderRegionActions
props.description: Actions in the selected region's detail panel (e.g. "Open dashboard", "Drain").

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Selected region id (shows its detail and highlights its marker and row).

props.name: sort
props.description: Table sort. Default: status, worst first. `null` keeps the order of `regions`.

props.name: view
props.description: Flat map (default) or globe.

props.name: viewToggle
props.description: Show the map / globe toggle. Default true.

RegisterWithKunji.description: First-time kunji registration: handle with live rules, name, invite code, then awaiting approval if needed.

props.name: firstAdmin
props.description: First person on the server becomes its admin.

props.name: joinPolicy
props.description: How new people join.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Create the account. Return `{ pending: true }` (or use `joinPolicy="approval"`) to show `AwaitingApproval`.

props.name: sub
props.description: kunji identity being registered.

RemoteCursor.description: Colored pointer/caret with a name label for another collaborator; the label fades when idle.

props.name: x
props.description: Position inside the nearest positioned ancestor (px number or any CSS length).

props.name: caretHeight
props.description: Caret height in px. Default 20.

props.name: color
props.description: Defaults to a color derived from `id ?? name`.

props.name: idleTimeout
props.description: Hide the name label after this many ms without movement. Default 3000; 0 keeps it.

props.name: variant
props.description: `arrow` for canvases, `caret` for text editors.

RemoteScreenViewer.description: Frame for an agent's computer-use screen: state, control lease, fit / fullscreen, latency and screenshot. Bring your own VNC canvas.

props.name: children
props.description:
Your remote-desktop surface. Sutra does not bundle a VNC / RDP client: mount e.g. a noVNC
`RFB` canvas (or a WebRTC `<video>`) here and it is scaled into the frame.

props.name: controller
props.description: Who holds the input lease.

props.name: fit
props.description: Scale-to-fit (default) or actual size with scrolling.

props.name: frameSrc
props.description: Alternative to `children`: an image stream (MJPEG URL or the latest screenshot data URL).

props.name: latencyMs
props.description: Round-trip latency in ms.

props.name: onReconnect
props.description: Shows a Reconnect button while disconnected.

props.name: onScreenshot
props.description: Shows a screenshot button.

props.name: screenWidth
props.description: Remote desktop width / height, used for the aspect ratio and "actual size". Default 1280×800.

ReorderableList.description:
Accessible reorderable list: drag handle with placeholder, Space-to-lift keyboard moves, optional arrow buttons, live announcements.
A generic plain function (React 19 `ref` prop) rather than `forwardRef`, which would erase the item type `T`.

props.name: flip
props.description:
Rows glide to their new place when the order changes (while dragging, with the keyboard or the buttons), and a
dropped row settles from where it was let go (`useFlip`; pass options to tune it). Off under reduced motion. Default true.

props.name: getLabel
props.description: Text used in announcements and button labels. Defaults to `String(item)`.

props.name: handle
props.description: Show the drag handle (pointer drag + keyboard pick-up). Default true.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list.

props.name: moveButtons
props.description: Show up / down buttons on each row.

RepeatButton.description: Tri-state repeat toggle cycling off → all → one.

props.name: id
props.description: The request id to show and copy.

RequestInspector.description: LLM / API request record: header, param chips and Messages | Request | Response | Raw tabs.

props.name: hideHeader
props.description: Hide the header (when rendered under a table row that already shows it).

RequestLogTable.description: Filterable, paginated request log with rows that expand into a RequestInspector.

props.name: expandedId
props.description: Controlled expanded record id.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows per page. Default 20.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Extra toolbar content (refresh button, date picker…).

ResetPasswordCard.description: Set a new password with strength meter and confirmation; success state afterwards.

props.name: description
props.default: "Your new password must be different from previously used passwords."

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: onContinue
props.description: Called from the success state's "Continue" button.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

ResourceHero.description: Endpoint / service header: name, status, copyable endpoint, uptime, readiness and config chips.

props.name: chips
props.description: Config chips (key → value).

props.name: endpoint
props.description: Endpoint URL with a copy button.

props.name: ready
props.type: { ready: number; total: number; noun?: string }
props.description: "N of M ready" counter.

ResponseRating.description: Good / Bad rating with optional follow-up reason chips and a thank-you state.

props.name: badReasons
props.description: Reason chips after a bad rating. Empty to submit immediately.

props.name: goodReasons
props.description: Reason chips after a good rating. Empty (default) to submit immediately.

props.name: prompt
props.description: Prompt beside the thumbs. Default "How did this go?".

ReviewFileTree.description: Changed files as a directory tree with colored A / M / D / R status letters and single selection.

props.name: onOpenFile
props.description: Called on click / Enter on a file.

props.name: selected
props.description: Selected file path.

props.name: showStats
props.description: Per-file +/− counts. Default false.

ReviewScopeTabs.description: Uncommitted / Branch vs base / Last turn scope switch with file counts.

props.name: baseBranch
props.description: Base branch for the "Branch vs base" label.

props.name: counts
props.description: File counts per scope.

props.name: scopes
props.description: Hide scopes, e.g. "turn" outside a session.

RewindButton.description: Message-action icon button that opens a `RewindDialog`.

props.name: message
props.description: Preview of the target message.

props.name: files
props.description: Files that would be restored.

props.name: fork
props.description: Show the fork notice when the conversation is rewound. Default true.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label and tooltip. Default "Rewind to here".

props.name: timestamp
props.description: When the target message was sent.

RewindDialog.description: Rewind to a message/checkpoint: preview, "What to restore" choice, file summary and fork notice.

props.name: message
props.description: Preview of the target message.

props.name: files
props.description: Files that would be restored.

props.name: fork
props.description: Show the fork notice when the conversation is rewound. Default true.

props.name: forkNotice
props.default: "A new forked conversation will be created; the current one stays in your history."

props.name: timestamp
props.description: When the target message was sent.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`).

RichEmbed.description: Renders a URL as a provider embed (after consent) or a link card. The iframe src is only built into the DOM post-consent.

props.name: consented
props.description: Skip the consent gate (only when your app already obtained consent).

props.name: image
props.description: Image slot for the link-card fallback (app-provided).

props.name: onAllowAlways
props.description:
Fired with the consent key when the user picks "Always allow": the provider id (e.g. `"youtube"`),
or `"<id>:<origin>"` for origin-scoped providers such as Mastodon (`"mastodon:<origin>"`).
Store it as-is in `EmbedConsentProvider`'s `allowed` list.

props.name: onConsent
props.description: Fired when the embed is loaded after consent, with the provider id and the consent key.

props.name: title
props.description: Title for the local preview, the iframe title and the link card.

RichTextEditor.description:
TipTap 3 WYSIWYG editor (StarterKit + Link + Placeholder) with Sutra prose styling, a bubble
toolbar on selection and/or a fixed `RichTextToolbar`, controlled HTML or JSON value.

The extension setup (`extensions`, `starterKit`, `history`, `placeholder`) is read when the editor is
created, as in TipTap; remount with a new `key` to change it. For Yjs: `history={false}` plus
`extensions={[Collaboration.configure({ document: ydoc })]}`, and leave `value`/`defaultValue` unset.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the editable content area.

props.name: editorRef
props.description: Receives the TipTap editor instance.

props.name: extensions
props.description:
Extra TipTap extensions (mentions, tables, Collaboration…), appended after the built-ins. Read once at mount:
the TipTap editor is created once, so remount (change `key`) to apply a different set.

props.name: format
props.description: Default "html".

props.name: history
props.description:
StarterKit's undo/redo history. Default true. Set false when something else owns undo, e.g. Yjs through TipTap's
Collaboration extension (which brings its own undo/redo, so the toolbar buttons stay). Without a replacement the
toolbar's undo/redo buttons are hidden. Read once at mount (remount with a new `key` to change it); wins over
`starterKit.undoRedo`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the editable area. Default "Rich text editor".

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every edit with the serialized value and the TipTap editor.

props.name: size
props.description: Prose size. Default "md".

props.name: starterKit
props.description:
StarterKit options merged over the defaults (`{ link: false }`; the editor adds its own Link). Set a key to `false`
to drop that extension, e.g. `{ heading: { levels: [1, 2] }, codeBlock: false }`. Read once at mount.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: "bubble" (on selection), "fixed" (above), "both" or "none". Default "bubble".

props.name: value
props.description: HTML string (`format="html"`) or ProseMirror JSON (`format="json"`).

RichTextToolbar.description: Fixed formatting toolbar for a `RichTextEditor` (or any TipTap editor with StarterKit + Link).

props.name: children
props.description: Extra tools appended after the defaults.

props.name: history
props.description:
Undo / redo buttons. Default true; they are left out anyway when the editor has no undo/redo commands
(`RichTextEditor history={false}` without a replacement such as TipTap's Collaboration extension).

RingMeter.description:
Compact ring showing a fill level against thresholds (role="meter"), e.g. an AI context window.
It draws the same ring as `ProgressCircle` (`ProgressRingSvg`); use `ProgressCircle` for task completion (role="progressbar").

props.name: value
props.description: Value in `max` units (percent by default). `null` means no reading yet: an empty track.

props.name: accent
props.description:
Categorical ring colour (a provider or metric colour). Colour order: the warning/danger threshold colours, then
`tone`/`color`, then `accent`, then primary. Sets `--sutra-accent` on the root.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra content after the ring, e.g. a token count.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, e.g. "Context window".

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the first reading: with `value` null, the track stays empty and a placeholder stands in for the percentage.

props.name: showValueAbove
props.description: Show the percentage beside the ring once it reaches this percent. Default 50. Use 0 to always show.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px. Default 20.

props.name: tone
props.description: Base tone below thresholds. Default `primary`.

RotatingNoticeBar.description: Global notice strip that rotates through notices with a dot pager, pausing on hover or focus. Renders an `AlertBanner`.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Default true. Always off under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.name: interval
props.description: Seconds per notice. Default 6.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Persist a dismissal (the bar hides it locally either way).

props.name: sticky
props.description: Stick to the top. Default false.

RotatingQRPairing.description: Live pairing QR: polls a rotating payload, crossfades on change, counts down and walks through pairing phases. Built on `QRCodeCard`.

props.name: getPayload
props.description: Polled while waiting for a scan. Return the current pairing payload (or `{ connected: true }`).

props.name: expiresAt
props.description: Absolute deadline (ms epoch) for the whole pairing session.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Called by the Refresh / Retry button, after the phase returns to waiting.

props.name: pollInterval
props.description: Poll interval in ms. Default 2000.

props.name: ttl
props.description: Session lifetime in seconds, restarted on refresh. Ignored when `expiresAt` is set.

RuleScopePicker.description: Inline destination link ("in this session ▾") that opens a menu of rule scopes.

props.name: prefix
props.description: Text before the link (visually). Default "in".

RunHistory.description: Past runs of a job: start, duration, status, cost/tokens, trigger, error snippet and a transcript link.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no runs. Default "No runs yet".

props.name: hasMore
props.description: More runs exist on the server; "Load more" calls `onLoadMore` once local runs are exhausted.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Runs revealed per "Load more". Default 5.

RunTicker.description: One-line rolling activity reel: each new line pushes the previous one up and out. Click to see every line.

props.name: label
props.description: Label before the reel.

props.name: running
props.description: Shows a spinner while true.

SandboxedFrame.description: An iframe with a strict sandbox, permissions allow-list, no referrer leakage and lazy loading.

props.name: title
props.description: Required accessible title.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width / height ratio (e.g. 16/9). Ignored when `height` is set.

props.name: height
props.description: Fixed height in px.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Class for the outer wrapper.

SaveStatus.description: Autosave indicator: saved (with relative time), unsaved, saving, error with retry, conflict with actions.

props.name: error
props.description: Error detail shown in the tooltip.

props.name: labels
props.description: Override the default labels.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time (tests / SSR); disables the refresh timer.

props.name: onKeepMine
props.description: Conflict: overwrite the server copy with this one.

props.name: onLoadTheirs
props.description: Conflict: load the other copy.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Conflict: open a resolver (e.g. `ConflictResolver`).

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows a Retry button in the error state.

props.name: savedAt
props.description: Last successful save; renders "Saved 2m ago" (refreshed every 30 s).

ScatterChart.description: Scatter (and bubble) chart: nearest-point hover, keyboard stepping in x order, toggleable series and reference lines.

props.name: data
props.description: One row per observation: an x value plus a y value for each series (and a size when `sizeKey` is set).

props.name: index
props.description: Key of the x value in each datum.

props.name: animate
props.description: CSS transitions on data changes (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion). Default true.

props.name: bubbleSize
props.description: Radius in px of the smallest and the largest bubble. Default: 4 up to 22 on a wide chart, a smaller maximum as it narrows.

props.name: grid
props.description: Gridlines. Default both.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px (legend excluded). Default 280.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to a description built from the series.

props.name: legend
props.description: Default: shown below for 2+ series.

props.name: legendInteractive
props.description: Allow toggling/isolating series from the legend. Default true.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no data, a placeholder plot (and legend) of the same size; with data, the root is marked busy.

props.name: onActivePointChange
props.type: (point: { seriesKey: string; index: number } | null) => void
props.description: The point under the pointer or keyboard focus: its series key and index in `data`, or null.

props.name: pointSize
props.description: Radius in px of points that have no `sizeKey`. Default 4.5.

props.name: referenceLines
props.description: Threshold lines: horizontal at a value, or vertical (`axis: "x"`) at an x value.

props.name: sizeFormatter
props.description: Formats bubble sizes (tooltip and table).

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats y values.

props.name: yAxis

ScrollArea.description: Custom-styled scroll container with thin overlay scrollbars and optional edge fades.

props.name: fadeEdges

ScrollBar.description: Thin scrollbar track + thumb; rendered automatically by `ScrollArea`.

ScrollProgressBar.description:
A thin bar that fills as the scroller scrolls (the `scroll-progress-bar` utility plus the script fallback). Decorative
(`aria-hidden`); place it `sticky top-0` inside a scroll area or `fixed inset-x-0 top-0` for the page. Empty where no
timeline or script can drive it, and under reduced motion.

props.name: forceFallback
props.description: Run the script fallback even where the browser has native scroll timelines. Default false.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element to follow. Default: the nearest scrolling ancestor, else the page.

ScrollReveal.description:
Fades and moves its content in as it scrolls into view, scrubbed by the scroll position (it reverses when you scroll
back). It is the `scroll-reveal` utility plus the script fallback: browsers with `animation-timeline` run it as a CSS
animation with no JavaScript; others get `--sutra-progress` from `useScrollProgress`, and with neither the content is
simply there. Reduced motion shows the end state at once. Not for dense tables, live data or anything above the fold
that must be readable on load. It replaces the element's own `translate` and `scale`, so wrap, do not stack. Keep it out of `overflow-hidden` wrappers (a native timeline binds to the nearest clipping ancestor, which never scrolls): use `overflow-clip` there.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Default `div`.

props.name: distance
props.description: Travel in px for the sliding directions. Default 24.

props.name: forceFallback
props.description: Run the script fallback even where the browser has native scroll timelines (to try the Firefox path). Default false.

props.name: from
props.description: Where it comes from as it enters: slides up (default), down, from the inline start or end, or only fades or scales in.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element for the script fallback. Default: the nearest scrolling ancestor, else the page.

ScrollStage.description:
A sticky stage over a scroll runway: the stage stays in view while you scroll through the runway, and
`--sutra-progress` (0 at the start, 1 at the end) is set on the stage root so its children can follow it in CSS
(`opacity-(--p)` with `--p: clamp(0, (var(--sutra-progress, 1) - .3) / .4, 1)`). Scrolling stays native: no
hijacking, no snapping, keyboard and touch work as usual, and the content can be focused and read at any progress.
Without script, or under reduced motion, the variable is unset (children read it with a default of 1, their end
state) and the stage is an ordinary block with no runway.

props.name: onScrollProgress
props.description: Called with the progress (0..1) in a frame while it changes.

props.name: runway
props.description: Length of the scroll runway: a CSS length, or a number of viewport heights. Default 3 (`300vh`).

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element. Default: the nearest scrolling ancestor, else the page.

props.name: stageHeight
props.description: Height of the sticky stage: a CSS length. Default `100dvh`; use a fixed length inside a scroll area.

SearchInput.description: Search field with an icon, a keyboard shortcut hint and a clear button.

props.name: className
props.description:
Classes for the element that renders. Without addons that is the `<input>` itself (the root).
With addons (`leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `clearable`) it lands on the
**inner** `<input>`, not the outer wrapper, so layout classes (`w-48`, `flex-1`, margins) have no
visible effect there; use `wrapperClassName` for those.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Shows a clear button while the field has a value.

props.name: hotkey
props.description:
Global shortcut that focuses the field, e.g. "/" or "mod+k" (⌘ on macOS, Ctrl elsewhere).
Also rendered as a key hint unless `shortcut` is provided.

props.name: prefix

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Custom key hint shown while the field is empty (strings render as `Kbd`).

props.name: suffix
props.description: Text addon after the field, e.g. ".com".

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon or small action rendered inside the field after the text.

props.name: variant
props.description: `outline` (default) is the bordered box; `filled` is a tinted surface with a hidden border.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description:
Classes for the outer wrapper `<div>`, which is only rendered when addons are present. Put
layout/sizing classes here when the input has addons.

props.name: label

props.name: onTrigger

props.name: placeholder

props.description: Tooltip in icon mode. Defaults to `children` when it is a string.

SidebarMenuItem.description: Wrapper for a menu button (and its sub menu).

SidebarMenuSub.description: Collapsible nested menu under a menu item. Hidden in icon mode.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current page (sets `aria-current="page"`).

props.name: label
props.description: Or let the sub menu render its own trigger button.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Custom trigger element (wrapped with Collapsible.Trigger asChild).

SidebarMenuSubButton.description: Nested link row inside `SidebarMenuSub`. Wrapped in its own list item.

props.name: active
props.description: Marks the current page (sets `aria-current="page"`).

SidebarProvider.description: Holds collapsed / mobile state, registers ⌘B, and lays out sidebar + inset.

props.name: contained
props.description:
Fill the parent element instead of the viewport (for previews, panels and nested layouts).
The parent needs a definite height.

props.name: iconWidth
props.description: CSS width in icon mode. Default "3rem".

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Key used with ⌘/Ctrl to toggle. Default "b". Pass `null` to disable.

props.name: width
props.description: CSS width of the expanded sidebar. Default "16rem".

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

SidebarUserCard.description: Account row with an `Avatar` (solid seed colour), name, email and chevron. Use as a dropdown trigger.

props.name: avatarColor
props.description: Background of the initials circle. Defaults to a color derived from the name.

props.name: avatarSrc
props.description: Image URL; falls back to initials.

props.name: hideChevron
props.description: Hide the trailing chevron.

SideThread.description: Docked mini-chat for quick side questions that don't interrupt the main conversation. Resizable from its top edge.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no exchanges yet.
props.default: "Ask a quick side question without interrupting the main conversation."

props.name: loading
props.description: Disables asking while an answer is pending. Default: any exchange is pending.

props.name: onAsk
props.description: Called with the question text from the side composer.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Show the top resize handle (pointer drag, ↑/↓, PageUp/PageDown, Home/End). Default true.

props.name: step
props.description: Keyboard resize step in px. Default 16.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title. Default "Side question".

SignedInPanel.description: Signed-in summary: `AccountPanel` plus kunji linking, sign out and sign out everywhere.

props.name: client
props.description: Enables "Link kunji" when given.

props.name: handle
props.description: Handle or email under the name.

props.name: onSignOutEverywhere
props.description: Ends every session (with a confirm dialog).

props.name: role
props.description: Role badge, e.g. "Admin".

SignInMap.description:
Where sign-ins come from: outcome-toned markers (clustered) on a flat map or globe, impossible-travel arcs,
new-country flags, a summary row and a list of flagged sign-ins with review and revoke actions.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Default `map`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Replaces the default "No sign-ins" view.

props.name: events
props.description: Sign-in attempts in any order. Events without a valid point or time are left out.

props.name: knownCountries
props.description:
Countries each account already signs in from (alpha-2). A first successful sign-in from any other country is a
new location. Omitted: the country of each account's earliest successful sign-in is its baseline.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: skeletons with no events yet, otherwise the events stay on screen (a refresh).

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for country names, dates and numbers.

props.name: maxKmh
props.description: Fastest plausible travel in km/h; faster pairs are flagged. Default 900 (a passenger jet).

props.name: minDistanceKm
props.description:
Pairs closer than this are never flagged, since IP geolocation is only city-accurate (a phone on mobile data can
appear a region away). Default 100.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for relative times (tests, stories). Default: the clock, updated every 30 s.

props.name: onReview
props.description: Shows a "Review" action on flagged events and the selected event's details.

props.name: onRevoke
props.description: Shows "Revoke" on successful sign-ins other than the current one. May return a promise (the button spins until it settles).

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.type: (id: string | null, event: SignInEvent | undefined) => void

props.name: reviewLabel
props.description: Default "Review".

props.name: revokeLabel
props.description: Default "Revoke".

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Selected event id: highlighted on the map, in the flagged list and shown in the detail panel.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading. Default "Sign-in activity".

props.name: viewToggle
props.description: Show the map / globe switch. Default true.

props.name: windowLabel
props.description: The period the events cover, next to the title ("Last 7 days").

SignInMethods.description: Sign-in method tabs (kunji QR, username + password, access token) that remember the last one used.

props.name: methods
props.description: Methods to offer, in order. Default all three.

props.name: rememberKey
props.description: localStorage key for the last used method. `null` disables remembering.

props.name: usernameLabel
props.description: Label of the username field, e.g. "Lab username".

SignUpCard.description: Account creation card: name, email, password with strength meter and terms checkbox.

props.name: description
props.default: "Start your free 14-day trial. No credit card required."

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: minScore
props.description: Minimum strength score (1–4) required to submit. Default 2.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

SimpleSelect.description: Data-driven select: pass `options` and get a styled trigger + list.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the select. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the select required. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Skip the tooltip entirely (renders children only).

props.name: shortcut
props.description:
Keyboard shortcut. A keys spec ("mod+k", "g t") renders platform-aware chips; a glyph string ("⌘K")
or an array (["⌘", "K"]) renders one Kbd per entry.

props.name: lines
props.description: Number of text lines (shape "text" only). The last line is shorter.

props.name: shimmer
props.description: Shimmer sweep instead of a pulse. Default true.

SkillCard.description: Skill list card: name, description, provenance, category, toolset icons and an enable switch.

SkillDetail.description: Skill detail: header with actions, SKILL.md preview, frontmatter and security scan tabs.

props.name: markdown
props.description: SKILL.md body (markdown).

SkipButton.description: Circular-arrow button that skips back or forward a number of seconds.

props.name: onSkip
props.description: Called with the signed delta, e.g. `-10`.

props.name: seconds
props.description: Seconds to skip (drawn inside the glyph). Default 10.

SlashMenu.description: Inline command / mention listbox anchored to the caret of a composer textarea.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The composer textarea to attach to.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Default "No matching commands".

props.name: filter
props.description: Custom filter; default matches name/keywords (prefix matches first).

props.name: heading
props.description: Header label. Default "Commands" (or "Mentions" for "@").

props.name: maxRows
props.description: Max visible rows before scrolling. Default 8.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Trigger character(s). Default "/". Use "@" for mentions.

Slider.description:
Range input with one or more thumbs, optional value bubble and labeled marks. `ref` and `className` land on the
outer wrapper (which also holds the marks); the other props go to the Radix slider root inside it.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the range, thumb border and active marks. Default primary.

props.name: getValueText
props.description: Accessible value text per thumb (`aria-valuetext`), e.g. `(v) => v + "%"`.

props.name: marks
props.description: Tick marks under the track; numbers or `{ value, label }`.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show a value bubble above the thumb on hover, focus and drag. `"always"` keeps it visible.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible labels per thumb, e.g. `["Minimum", "Maximum"]`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour (`success`, `warning`, …). Takes precedence over `accent`.

SlideToConfirm.description:
Confirm an irreversible action by sliding the thumb along the track. It is a `role="slider"` (value 0 to 100, arrow keys step,
Home resets, End and Enter and Space confirm), the offset follows the finger without React state (`useDrag`), a release short of
90% springs back, and under reduced motion the release is instant. `onConfirm` may return a promise: the control stays busy
until it settles and slides back if it rejects.

props.name: confirmed
props.description: The thumb is at the end. Pass `false` to slide it back after a confirmation.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon on the thumb. Default a chevron.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible hint, also the slider's accessible name. Default "Slide to confirm".

props.name: loading
props.description: Thumb at the end with a spinner while the action runs (a promise from `onConfirm` does the same by itself).

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Shown while the action runs. Default "Confirming…".

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs once the thumb reaches the end (or Enter, Space or End is pressed). A returned promise keeps the control busy; a rejection slides it back.

props.name: step
props.description: Arrow key step in percent of the track. Default 10.

SlotFill.description:
Declaratively contribute `children` to a slot while mounted. Renders nothing in place.
Registers once per slot/id/order/source; later `children` updates re-render only the filled content.

props.name: slot
props.description: Target slot name.

props.name: id
props.description: Stable id; defaults to a generated one.

SlotOutlet.description: Renders every contribution registered for `name`, in order, each isolated by an error boundary.

props.name: name
props.description: Slot name, e.g. "sidebar.footer".

props.name: fallback
props.description: Rendered when nothing is registered.

props.name: onContributionError
props.description: Called when a contribution throws while rendering.

props.name: unwrapped
props.description: Render contributions without the wrapper div.

SlotProvider.description: Provides a slot registry to `SlotOutlet` and `SlotFill` below it.

props.name: contributions
props.description: Initial contributions when no `registry` is given.

props.name: registry
props.description: Use an existing registry (e.g. one plugins register into at startup).

Snackbar.description: Compact dark (inverse) notification bar with an optional action, Material-style.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a dismiss button when provided.

SocialButton.description: OAuth sign-in button with the provider's logo. Defaults to "Continue with {Provider}".

SortFilterMenu.description: View options menu with sort radio items, direction and checkbox filters.

SourcePane.description: Source text pane: auto-growing textarea, counter, clear, did-you-mean strip, voice/speak slots, RTL.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text when uncontrolled. Default "".

props.name: lang
props.description: Language code of the text (drives `dir` and `lang`).

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Character limit. Default 5000.

props.name: minHeight
props.description: Minimum textarea height in px. Default 128.

props.name: speak
props.description: Slot for a SpeakButton (default renders one for `lang` when text is present).

props.name: suggestion
props.description: "Did you mean" correction.

props.name: textareaProps
props.description: Props passed to the textarea.

props.name: tools
props.description: Extra footer tools (e.g. a TransliterationToggle).

props.name: voice
props.description: Slot for a VoiceInput.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour (`blue`, `amber`, …, a semantic token or any CSS colour). `tone` and `color` take precedence.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour (token names still work; prefer `tone` for those). Default primary.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between bars in px (viewBox units).

props.name: max
props.description: Fixed scale top (e.g. 100 for percentages). Defaults to the larger of 0 and the data maximum.

props.name: min
props.description: Fixed scale bottom (e.g. 0). Defaults to the smaller of 0 and the data minimum.

props.name: mutedColor
props.description: Color for non-highlighted bars when `highlightLast` is on. Defaults to a faded `color`.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour. Takes precedence over `color`.

props.name: accent
props.description:
Categorical colour (`blue`, `amber`, …, a semantic token or any CSS colour). `tone` and `color` take
precedence. Pass `color="var(--sutra-accent, var(--primary))"` to follow an accent set by a parent instead.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour (token names such as "primary" still work; prefer `tone` for those).

props.name: gradient
props.description: Gradient under the line (`type="area"`). Default true.

props.name: highlightLast
props.description: Dot on the last data point.

props.name: min
props.description: Fixed y-domain; defaults to the data range.

props.name: responsive
props.description: Stretch to 100% of the container width.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour. Takes precedence over `color`.

props.name: trend
props.description: Color green when the series ends higher than it started, red otherwise.

props.name: width
props.description: Intrinsic width (or viewBox width when `responsive`).

SpeakButton.description: Reads text aloud with the system voice for `lang`; hidden when no such voice exists.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label while idle. Default "Listen".

props.name: lang
props.description: BCP-47 language of `text`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

Spinner.description: Loading indicator. Uses `currentColor`, so set a text color to recolor it.

props.name: frames
props.description: glyph only: a built-in frame set or custom frames. Default "dots".

props.name: interval
props.description: glyph only: milliseconds per frame. Default 80.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label. Default "Loading". Pass `""` to make the spinner decorative (hidden from assistive tech).

props.name: paused
props.description: glyph only: hold the current frame.

props.name: variant
props.description:
ring: arc spinner · dots: three bouncing dots · bars: equalizer · pulse: breathing dot ·
glyph: cycling text glyphs (braille dots, arcs, …; inherits font size and colour unless `size` is set).

The box variants scale with their box, so `className="h-1.5 w-6"` gives a compact row of dots.

SpinnerVerbs.description: Loader that rotates through whimsical verbs with a shimmer, elapsed time and token count.
SpinnerVerbs.deprecated: Use `<AgentStatusLine state="thinking" verbs={…} layout="inline" tokensPrefix="↓" />`; this is now a preset of it.

props.name: hint
props.description: Optional hint after the stats, e.g. "esc to interrupt".

props.name: interval
props.description: Ms between verbs. Default 3000.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible status label. Default "Working".

props.name: order
props.description: Default "random".

props.name: startedAt
props.description: Shows elapsed time when set.

SplitButton.description: A primary action fused with a chevron that opens a menu of secondary actions.

props.name: actions
props.description: Secondary actions listed in the chevron menu.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: groupClassName
props.description: Class for the outer group.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: menuContent
props.description: Custom menu content (rendered after `actions`).

props.name: menuHeading
props.description: Optional heading inside the menu.

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chevron button. Default "More options".

props.name: size
props.description: Button's text-size scale; the chevron uses the matching icon size. Default "md".

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

SplitPane.description: Two resizable panes with an accessible draggable divider, persistence and a narrow-width fallback.

props.name: collapseBelow
props.description: Below this container width (px) the split collapses.

props.name: collapseMode
props.description: When collapsed: stack both panes, or show one at a time with a toggle. Default "stack".

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Allow Enter on the handle to collapse/restore the first panel. Default true.

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Initial size of the first panel in percent; also the double-click reset value. Default 50.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum first-panel size in percent. Default 85.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum first-panel size in percent. Default 15.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal`: panes side by side (vertical divider). `vertical`: stacked (horizontal divider).

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the first panel in percent (controlled).

props.name: step
props.description: Keyboard step in percent (Shift ×2). Default 5.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Persist the size in localStorage under this key.

SplitPaneHandle.description: Draggable divider: `role="separator"` with arrows/Home/End, Enter to collapse, double-click to reset.

props.name: withGrip
props.description: Show a grip in the middle of the divider. Default true.

SplitPanePanel.description: One side of a `SplitPane`. The first panel is sized; the second fills the rest.

props.name: label
props.description: Label used by the narrow-width toggle (`collapseMode="primary"`).

SplitText.description:
Text that reveals itself character by character or word by word (`animate-fade-up` plus the `stagger` delay on `--i`).
Accessible by construction: the real text sits once in a visually hidden span, and the pieces are `aria-hidden`, so a
screen reader never hears letters, and copying and find-in-page still see words (a word stays unbroken at line ends).
Under `prefers-reduced-motion`, or with `animate={false}`, it renders the plain text.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. Screen readers get it whole.

props.name: animate
props.description: Set false to show the text as it is, with no reveal (changing it replays the reveal when true). Default true.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. Default `span`.

props.name: by
props.description: Reveal by character or by word. Default "char".

props.name: effect
props.description: The entrance of each piece. Default "fade-up".

props.name: step
props.description: Milliseconds between pieces. Default 24 for characters, 70 for words. The whole reveal is capped at about 1.2 s.

Spotlight.description: A soft radial glow for heroes and cards.

props.name: animated
props.description: Slowly drift the glow.

props.name: color
props.description: Glow color (any CSS color). Defaults to the brand color.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in pixels.

props.name: x
props.description: Center position, as CSS lengths/percentages.

SpotlightCard.description:
A `Card` with a soft glow that follows the mouse (the `spotlight` utility on `usePointerVars`). It also glows at the
centre while something inside has keyboard focus. Touch, reduced motion and no hover leave it plain. Decoration only.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, so a card can sit in the page outline as an `article`, `section` or list item.

props.name: glowSize
props.description: Radius of the glow in px. Default 240 (the `--sutra-spotlight-size` token).

props.name: padded
props.description: Adds 24px (16px at `size="sm"`) of padding on the card itself; the parts carry their own padding instead.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` tightens the padding of the card and its parts.

SSOOnlyCard.description: Stack of OAuth buttons (plus optional SAML SSO) for SSO-only sign in.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: onSAML
props.description: Show a "Continue with SAML SSO" button.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

Stack.description: Flex stack on the 4px spacing grid.

StackedMeter.description: One bar split into colored parts with a legend (storage breakdown, wait vs. generate…).

props.name: legend
props.description:
Legend under the bar. `true` / `"inline"` (default): wrapping chips. `"list"`: one `BreakdownList` row per
part with the value right-aligned and a percent column. `false` hides it.

props.name: loading
props.description: Waiting for the first breakdown: with no `parts` the bar is a muted track and the legend shows placeholders.

props.name: max
props.description: Capacity. Defaults to the sum of parts (bar is full).

props.name: partSlot
props.description: `data-slot` of each part. Default "stacked-meter-part".

props.name: showPercent
props.description: Show each part's percentage (of `max`, else of the total) in the legend. Default false inline, true for `"list"`.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the label / value header. Default true.

props.name: trackProps
props.description:
Props for the bar itself. By default it is `role="img"` named by a parts summary; pass
`{ role: "meter", "aria-valuenow": … }` when the bar is a level against `max` (see `ContextUsageBreakdown`).

props.name: valueText
props.description: Text beside the label. Defaults to "used / max" when `max` is set.

StagedSetupHero.description: One-click local-model quickstart: stage rail with statuses, per-stage CTA, download progress and retry.

props.name: description
props.default: "Private, offline and free. We'll set everything up in a few steps."

props.name: download
props.description: Progress for the stage with id `download` (or `downloadStageId`).

props.name: readyContent
props.description: Content shown once every stage is done.

StatCard.description:
KPI tile: label, big value, delta, hint and optional sparkline. With `href`/`onClick` the label becomes a
link/button stretched over the card; keep other interactive content out of a linked card (or lift it with
`relative z-10`).

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the icon chip, label, trend and progress bar. `tone` stays for status.

props.name: animate
props.description: Roll the digits when a numeric `value` changes. Opt-in; strings and nodes render as given.

props.name: caption
props.description: Small text above the value ("Now", "In use of 64 GB").

props.name: chevron
props.description: Trailing chevron in the header. Default true when the card is a link or button.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra body content under the value and stats (a chart, a list).

props.name: delta
props.description: Change vs. a previous period. Numbers are shown signed with `deltaSuffix`.

props.name: deltaIntent
props.description: Whether up is good (green) or bad (red). Default positive-is-good.

props.name: deltaLabel
props.description: Comparison period, e.g. "vs last week".

props.name: deltaSuffix
props.description: Appended to numeric deltas. Default "%".

props.name: hint
props.description: Secondary line under the value.

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the label a link that covers the whole card.

props.name: iconPlacement
props.description: Icon chip before the label or in the top-right corner. Default start with `accent`/`href`/`onClick`, else end.

props.name: labelTone
props.description: Label colour: the accent (default when `accent` is set) or muted.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Shows placeholders instead of the value, hint, delta and stat values (the label, caption and stat labels stay);
the progress bar, trend and `children` body get placeholders of the same size.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the label a button that covers the whole card (when there is no `href`).

props.name: progress
props.description: A thin bar under the value (`progressMax` default 100).

props.name: stats
props.description: Row of small label/value pairs under the value (User 18% · System 8% · Average 39%).

props.name: status
props.description: Right-aligned next to the value, e.g. a `StatusBadge`.

props.name: trend
props.description: Sparkline values.

props.name: trendMax
props.description: Fixed upper bound of the trend scale (e.g. 100).

props.name: trendMin
props.description: Fixed lower bound of the trend scale (e.g. 0).

props.name: trendPlacement
props.description: `footer` draws the trend full-width at the bottom on an accent-tinted strip. Default inline.

props.name: value
props.description: The big number. Optional for cards whose body is `children` (e.g. a donut breakdown under the header).

props.name: valueFont
props.description: Number face for the value: monospaced (default) or the UI sans with tabular figures.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options for an animated `value`.

props.name: valueLocale
props.description: Locale for an animated `value`.

StatementHero.description: A centred statement section: big mark, headline, short subtitle, one action and a hint.

props.name: title
props.description: The statement. Set in a big, tight, balanced display size that steps down on phones.

props.name: action
props.description: The one action, e.g. a pill `Button size="xl"` or a `FileUploadTrigger`.

props.name: align
props.description: Centre everything (default) or align it to the start edge.

props.name: animated
props.description: Stagger the parts in with `animate-fade-up` (off under reduced motion). Default true.

props.name: as
props.description: Heading element for the title. Default `h1`.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two lines under the title (muted, large, balanced).

props.name: float
props.description: Let the media bob gently (`animate-bob`; it stands still under reduced motion).

props.name: hint
props.description: A small muted line under the action.

props.name: media
props.description: A big mark or icon above the headline.

props.name: size
props.description: `lg` is the landing-page statement (110px headline on desktop), `md` a compact section.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns on wide screens. Default 4.

props.name: variant
props.description: "cards": separate tiles; "divided": one panel with hairline dividers. Default cards.

StatusBadge.description: Status pill with a colored dot (or a spinner / icon).

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading indicator: `"dot"` (default), `"spinner"`, any icon node, or `null` for none. Always decorative.

props.name: pulse
props.description: Animated halo. Defaults to true for `processing`.

props.name: tone

StatusStack.description: Stack of status rows above a composer; collapsed it shows the top row plus "+N more".

props.name: label

StatusStackRow.description: Generic status row: glyph, label, "·"-separated facts, title, actions and an optional progress bar.

props.name: actions

StatusStrip.description:
Live infrastructure status above the composer: model warm-up, queue position, retry / rate-limit
countdown, offline and errors. Live region: `role="status"` (polite); ticking clocks and countdowns are
hidden from screen readers so only state changes are announced.

This covers the platform, not the agent: for what the agent itself is doing (thinking, running a tool,
waiting for permission) use `AgentStatusLine`, which sits in the same slot. Show one at a time.

props.name: tone
props.description: Override the tone derived from the status kind.

StatValue.description: The big number of a metric with its unit, shared by StatCard and MetricHero.

props.name: animate
props.description:
Roll the digits when a numeric `value` changes (see `AnimatedNumber`). Opt-in: live fills and dense tables stay
still. Other values (strings, nodes) render as given. A number is formatted with `format` and `locale`.

props.name: size

props.name: unit
props.description: Smaller, muted suffix ("%", "GB").

StepWizard.description:
A multi-step flow in one place: the steps slide in the direction you are going, the area grows or shrinks to the
height of the current step, and a progress bar or `Steps` shows where you are. `canAdvance` validates before moving
forward (it may be async), Back is free, focus moves to the new step's panel so a screen reader announces it, and
Enter in a text field presses Next. Controlled with `value` or uncontrolled. Under reduced motion the steps swap
with no slide and the height jumps.

props.name: canAdvance
props.description:
Checked before leaving a step forward (Next, Finish, or a jump ahead); return false (or a promise of false) to stay.
While a promise is pending the buttons wait. Going back is never checked.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the Back / Next row, or pass false to hide it.

props.name: indicator
props.description: `"auto"` shows `Steps` from a container width of 28rem up and a progress bar below; or force one. Default "auto".

props.name: keepMounted
props.description: Keep every step mounted (hidden) so typed values survive going back. Default false: only the current step is rendered.

props.name: onBlocked
props.description: Called when `canAdvance` keeps the user on a step: show the error there.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: The Finish button was pressed on the last step (after `canAdvance`). It may return a promise; the button shows loading until it settles.

props.name: onError
props.description: `canAdvance` or `onComplete` threw or rejected: the wizard stays on the step.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (id: string, meta: { index: number; direction: "forward" | "back" }) => void

props.name: stepsProps
props.description: Passed to `Steps` (variant, size, connector).

props.name: value
props.description: Id of the step in view.

StorageMap.description: Disk usage map: a used/free header, a treemap of folders grouped by category (macOS, App data, Yours, Other) and a legend.

SubagentStatusGlyph.description: Small status glyph (a StatusDot preset): spinner (running), check (done), cross (failed), clock (waiting), forbid (canceled).

props.description: Opens the subagent's transcript (Enter on a node without children, or the open button).

props.name: onSteer
props.description: Sends steering text into a running subagent. Shows a Steer button on running nodes.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Stops a running subagent.

SuggestionDiff.description: AI proposal review: word diff of a suggestion with Accept / Discard and per-change accept / reject.

SutraAppIcon.description:
App icon for a Sutra suite app: a tile with a thread running across it, a bead on the thread and one pictogram in the bead.
The thread leaves the tile on both sides, so a row of icons reads as beads on one string.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner style of the tile.

props.name: size
props.description: Rendered pixel size (width and height).

props.name: title
props.description: Accessible title. When omitted, the graphic is hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of the icon. Default `mono`.

props.name: markOnly
props.description: Hide the wordmark and show only the mark.

props.name: markVariant
props.description: Which `SutraMark` variant leads the lockup. Default `glyph` (ink on paper).

props.name: product

SutraMark.description: The Sutra logomark: a bead strung on a thread. Ink on paper by default, so it follows the text colour.

props.name: size

props.name: title
