props.name: variant
props.description:
`glyph` the bead alone in `currentColor`, ink on paper (default),
`tile` the bead in ink on a paper tile with a hairline edge,
`reversed` paper bead on an ink tile (for dark surfaces),
`solid` flat `--primary` tile with a `--primary-foreground` bead (follows the theme and the paper style),
`outline` thin frame in `currentColor` around the bead,
`badge` heavy frame in `currentColor` around a bold bead.

SutraWordmark.description:
The lowercase "sutra" wordmark. Without `children` it is the drawn brand word (monoline, scales with the font size, real text for
screen readers); with `children` it sets your text in the brand sans.

props.name: gradient
props.description: Show the brand name in a gradient instead of `currentColor`.

SvgEmbed.description: Safely renders user-supplied SVG through an image data URL (no innerHTML, no script execution).

props.name: svg
props.description: SVG markup (untrusted). Rendered via an data URL, never injected as HTML, so scripts and remote refs don't run.

props.name: title

props.name: caption
props.description: Optional caption.

SwapButton.description: Swap source/target languages with a half-turn animation.

SwipeDeck.description:
Triage cards one at a time: drag the top card and it flies away (past 90 px or on a flick) or springs back, with a tilt of
0.05 degrees per px and the cards behind stepping up the stack as it goes. The same choices are Skip and Keep buttons, the
arrow keys and Enter on the focused deck, and Ctrl or Command + Z or the Undo button takes the last swipe back (the card
flies in again). `start` and `end` follow the reading direction, `onSwipe(side, item, index)` reports each choice, `onEmpty`
fires after the last card, `index` / `defaultIndex` / `onIndexChange` control the position. Screen readers get a labelled
group, the top card as "Card 2 of 8" and a polite announcement per swipe; the cards behind are `inert`. Built on `useDrag`,
so a drag writes CSS variables and never re-renders; reduced motion drops the flight (a swipe just changes the card).

props.name: getKey
props.description: A stable key per item (an id), so a card keeps its place and its flight when the list changes.

props.name: items
props.description: The cards in order; the top one is at `index`.

props.name: renderCard
props.description: The content of one card (the deck draws the card surface). Cards behind the top one render too: keep them cheap.

props.name: actions
props.description: Show the Skip, Undo and Keep buttons under the deck. Default true.

props.name: apiRef
props.description: Imperative handle (`swipe(side)`, `undo()`).

props.name: cardClassName
props.description: Classes of each card surface (give it a height).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignore drags, keys and buttons.

props.name: distance
props.description: Distance (px) of a drag that commits. Default 90.

props.name: endIcon
props.description: Icon of the end button. Default a check.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: Name of the end action (also Enter). Default "Keep".

props.name: getLabel
props.description: Names the item in the screen reader announcements ("Kept: Invoice 12"). Default: no name.

props.name: index
props.description: Index of the top card (`items.length` = none left).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the deck. Default "Card deck".

props.name: loading
props.description: Skeleton cards instead of items; the controls are hidden.

props.name: onEmpty
props.description: The last card was swiped away.

props.name: onSwipe
props.type: (side: SwipeDeckSide, item: T, index: number) => void
props.description: A card was dismissed to a side by a drag, a key or a button. `start` and `end` follow the reading direction.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: The last swipe was taken back.

props.name: stack
props.description: Cards that show in the stack (the top one included). Default 3.

props.name: startIcon
props.description: Icon of the start button. Default a cross.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: Name of the start action. Default "Skip".

SwipeRow.description:
A list row that follows the finger: drag it to reveal buttons at its start or end, or swipe all the way to run the outermost
one. It builds on `useDrag` (the offset lives in `--sutra-drag-x`, no render per move), rubber-bands past the end, releases
with a spring and opens at 40% of the actions' width. The actions are real buttons: Tab reaches them (a focused button opens
its side), Arrow keys on the row open and close it, Escape closes it, and `onAction` runs for buttons and swipes alike.
Use `Item` rows as the content; inside an `ItemGroup` the row itself is the list item.

props.name: actionsLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the action groups. Default "Actions".

props.name: actionWidth
props.description: Width of one action button in px, so the reveal distance is known without measuring. Default 72.

props.name: commit
props.description: A full swipe runs the outermost action. Default true; false stops at the revealed actions.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes of the sliding content layer (it must stay opaque to hide the actions). Default `bg-background`.

props.name: endActions
props.description: Actions revealed by dragging toward the inline start (left in left-to-right text).

props.name: onAction
props.description: Runs for a button press, a key press and a full swipe alike.

props.name: startActions
props.description: Actions revealed by dragging toward the inline end (right in left-to-right text).

props.name: value
props.description: Which side's actions are open (`null` closed).

Switch.description: Toggle switch with a springy thumb and optional thumb icons. Consumes `Field` context.

props.name: uncheckedIcon

SwitchGroup.description: Fieldset of switch rows separated by dividers. Use `options` + `value` record, or children.

TagInput.description: Text input that turns entries into removable tag chips, with optional suggestions.

props.name: addOnBlur
props.description: Commit the pending text when the input loses focus.

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: Allow the same tag more than once (case-insensitive comparison otherwise).

second press removes it. Typing, blur or any other key clears the mark, and a held key never confirms. Default false:
Backspace removes the last tag at once.

props.name: max

TallyCounter.description: Big tally number with −/+ (press and hold to repeat), step, goal ring and an entry log with undo.

TextButton.description: An action that reads as part of a sentence: inline text, underlined on hover. A link with `href`, a button otherwise.
TextButton.deprecated:
Use `TextLink`: `<TextLink onClick={…} variant="subtle">` (or `as="button"`) for the button form,
`<TextLink href>` for the link form. `tone` maps to `variant`: default → subtle, muted → muted, destructive → destructive.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an `<a>` when set; otherwise a `<button type="button">`.

TextLink.description:
Inline text link with underline styles and optional external indicator.
With `onClick` and no `href` (or `as="button"`) it renders a button that reads as part of the sentence.
For a standalone action use `Button variant="link"`.

props.name: as
props.description:
`button` renders a `<button type="button">` styled as a link, for an inline action inside a sentence.
Default: `button` when there is an `onClick` but no `href`, otherwise `a`.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a router Link).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the button, or in link mode renders an `aria-disabled` link without `href` that ignores clicks.

props.name: external
props.description: Opens in a new tab with safe `rel` and shows an arrow-up-right icon.

TextShimmer.description: Text with an animated light sweep, used for "Thinking…" style status lines.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render. Defaults to `span`.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one sweep of the highlight.

props.name: spread
props.description: Half-width of the bright band, as a percentage of the text width.

ThemeToggle.description: Light / dark / system switch: an animated icon button or a segmented control.

props.name: applyToDocument
props.description: Toggle the `dark` class / color-scheme on <html>. Default true.

props.name: modes
props.description: Modes offered, in cycle order. `["light", "dark"]` makes a two-state toggle.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Show labels next to icons in the segmented variant. Default true.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: localStorage key used when uncontrolled; `null` disables persistence.

props.name: variant
props.description: `icon` cycles through `modes` with a sun/moon morph; `segmented` shows all modes.

ThermalSensors.description: CPU / GPU / SSD / battery temperatures in a card, coloured by thresholds, with an optional °C / °F switch.

props.name: accent
props.description: Default "orange".

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `sensors` is empty. Default "No temperature sensors".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the list. Default "Temperature sensors".

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way. With no sensors yet the card shows placeholder rows; with sensors the root is only marked busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder sensors while loading. Default 4.

props.name: min
props.description: Scale bottom and top in °C. Default 20–110.

props.name: showUnitToggle
props.description: Show the °C / °F switch in the header. Default true when `onUnitChange` is set.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Default thresholds in °C for sensors without their own.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title. Default "Temperatures"; `null` hides the header (unless the unit switch is shown).

props.name: unit
props.description: Display unit (readings stay °C).

props.name: variant
props.description: `meter` rows (default) or a grid of `gauge`s.

ThinkingExpandAllProvider.description: Shares one "expand all thinking" switch with every ChainOfThought inside (e.g. a transcript).

ThinkingToggle.description: Toggle button that expands / collapses every ChainOfThought under a ThinkingExpandAllProvider.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render as the child element (e.g. a link) while keeping button styles.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and disables the button.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

TilingLayout.description: IDE-style tiling workspace: nested resizable splits of tab groups with drag-and-drop, zoom and keep-alive panes.

props.name: createPane
props.description:
Supply a new pane id for "Split right/down". Without it, splitting moves the tab into a
new group (or creates an empty group when it is the only tab).

props.name: defaultMaximizedGroup
props.description: Initially maximized group id when uncontrolled.

props.name: floating
props.description: Floating windows rendered over the layout; enables "Pop out" and "Dock".

props.name: keepAlive
props.description: Keep inactive tabs mounted (hidden) so their state survives. Default true.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the workspace. Default "Workspace".

props.name: maximizedGroup
props.description: Maximized group id (controlled).

props.name: minSize
props.description: Minimum fraction per split child. Default 0.08.

props.name: onPaneClose
props.description: Called after a pane was closed from the UI.

props.name: paneClosable
props.description: Whether a pane shows a close button. Default: all closable.

props.name: paneLabel
props.description: Plain-text name used in aria labels when `paneTitle` returns a node.

props.name: paneTitle
props.description: Tab title (default: the pane id).

props.name: renderEmptyGroup
props.description: Content for empty groups (default: a drop hint).

props.name: shortcuts
props.description: Register keyboard shortcuts (mod+\, mod+shift+\, mod+w, ctrl+tab, mod+1…9).

props.name: step
props.description: Keyboard resize step (fraction). Default 0.02.

TiltCard.description:
A `Card` that tilts toward the mouse in 3D. The pointer is read on a still wrapper (`data-slot="tilt-card-field"`)
and the card inside tilts, so it never moves out from under the pointer. Props and the ref go to the card. Touch,
reduced motion and no hover leave it flat. Use it for hero, plan and entity cards, not for dense or live content.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render, so a card can sit in the page outline as an `article`, `section` or list item.

props.name: max
props.description: Tilt at the edge, in degrees. Default 7 (the `--sutra-tilt-max` token; paper uses 3).

props.name: padded
props.description: Adds 24px (16px at `size="sm"`) of padding on the card itself; the parts carry their own padding instead.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` tightens the padding of the card and its parts.

props.name: spotlight
props.description: Add the pointer glow too. Default false.

TimelineBar.description: Time-window bar with spans per lane (session uptime, GPU job occupancy), live spans and a tick axis.

props.name: from
props.description: Window start.

props.name: to
props.description: Window end.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name.

props.name: labelWidth
props.description: Width of the lane label column in px. Default 112.

props.name: laneHeight
props.description: Lane height in px. Default 24.

props.name: lanes
props.description: Multiple labelled lanes.

props.name: now
props.description: Reference "now" for live spans. Default Date.now().

props.name: showNow
props.description: Show the "now" marker when inside the window. Default true.

props.name: spans
props.description: Single unlabelled lane (shorthand).

props.name: ticks
props.description: Number of tick intervals. Default 6; fewer are drawn when the axis is too narrow for their labels.

TimePicker.description:
Time field with hour, minute (and optional second / AM-PM) segments. Each segment is a spinbutton:
arrows step it, digits type into it, Backspace clears it. Value is a 24-hour `"HH:mm"` string.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Show an inline button that clears the time.

props.name: granularity
props.description: Show a seconds segment. Default `"minute"`.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: Force a 12- or 24-hour clock. Defaults to the locale's convention.

props.name: icon
props.description: Show the leading clock icon. Default true.

props.name: labels
props.description: Override the segment names and the clear button label (i18n).

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for the clock convention, segment order and AM/PM labels.

props.name: max
props.description: Latest allowed time (`"HH:mm"`).

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest allowed time (`"HH:mm"`). Values outside the range are clamped.

props.name: name
props.description: Submits the value under this name through a hidden input.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new time, or `undefined` when it is cleared or no longer complete.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required. Inherited from a surrounding `Field` when omitted.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes moved by the minute segment's arrow keys (snaps to multiples). Default 1.

props.name: value
props.description: Time as `"HH:mm"` (24-hour), or `"HH:mm:ss"` with `granularity="second"`. `undefined` means empty.

TimeScrubber.description: Range slider over time with a histogram of counts per bucket and chronological play/pause playback (Space toggles).

props.name: nodes
props.description: Items to histogram (only `createdAt` is used).

props.name: buckets
props.description: Histogram bucket count. Default 32.

props.name: duration
props.description: Full sweep duration at 1× in ms. Default 8000.

props.name: tickMs
props.description: Playback tick in ms. Default 100.

TipBubble.description: Dismissible contextual tip anchored to an element, with a rotating "Next tip" list.

props.name: tips
props.description: One or more tips; "Next tip" cycles through them.

props.name: children
props.description: Anchor element (wrapped with asChild). Use `target` instead to anchor to an existing element.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the bubble is closed.

props.name: onDontShowAgain
props.description: Shows a "Don't show again" action.

props.name: tone
props.description: Accent colour of the bar and icon. Default `primary`.

Toaster.description: Sonner toaster styled with Sutra tokens. Follows the `.dark` class on <html> unless `theme` is set.

TodayTimeline.description: Merged chronological agenda across apps: untimed section, hourly rail, now line and overlap layout.

props.name: density
props.description:
Rail spacing. `compact` tightens the hour rail; `normal` (default) and `relaxed` use the
roomy rail. The legacy `"comfortable"` is accepted as an alias of `relaxed`.

props.name: now
props.description: Fixed current time (otherwise the clock updates every minute).

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Toggle a task or habit.

props.name: startHour
props.description: First / last hour on the rail. Defaults fit the items within 8–20.

ToggleButton.description: A button that stays pressed (`aria-pressed`): bold, mute, pin. Controlled with `pressed`, or uncontrolled with `defaultPressed`.

ToggleGroup.description:
Row of toggle buttons, `type="single"` or `"multiple"`, with roving focus (one tab stop, arrow keys move). Each item
is a button with `aria-pressed`; give the group an `aria-label`. For an exclusive choice that reads as a tab-like
switch, `SegmentedControl` is the better fit.

props.name: loop
props.description: Wrap focus from the last item to the first (default true).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Arrow keys move along this axis (default horizontal).

props.name: type
props.description:
At most one item pressed; pressing it again clears the value to `""`.
Any number of items pressed.

ToggleGroupItem.description: One toggle in a `ToggleGroup`; `value` identifies it.

ToolGroup.description: Folds consecutive low-signal calls into one row ("Explored 6 files"), expandable to list them.

props.name: autoCollapse
props.description: Collapse when the group finishes running (uncontrolled only). Default true.

props.name: label
props.description: Custom label, e.g. ({ count }) => `Searched ${count} patterns`.

props.name: noun
props.description: Singular noun. Default "file".

props.name: pluralNoun
props.description: Plural noun. Default `${noun}s`.

props.name: runningVerb
props.description: Present participle while running. Default "Exploring".

props.name: status
props.description: Group status; derived from the children's `status` when omitted. Accepts `TaskStatus` values too.

props.name: verb
props.description: Past-tense verb. Default "Explored".

ToolHintTag.description: Small tag describing a tool's side effects.

ToolKeyValueBody.description: Generic label / value grid for tool inputs and results.

props.name: valueHeight
props.description: Height cap for each value before "Show more". Default 72.

ToolsetCard.description: Toolset summary card: icon, description, tool count, enabled switch, health pill and Configure.

props.name: healthMessage
props.description: Error or hint shown under the description.

ToolsetProviderDrawer.description: Side sheet to configure a toolset: on/off, backend provider, credentials and a post-setup install step.

props.name: onInstall
props.description: Post-setup install step (e.g. pip install). Omit to hide.

props.name: onSaveCredential
props.type: (providerId: string, key: string, value: string) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Store a credential. May return a promise.

ToolTimeline.description: Vertical rail of agent steps. Children are ToolTimelineItem, ToolGroup or ToolTimelineText (other nodes are wrapped as text).

ToolTimelineDot.description: Status dot on the timeline rail (a `StatusDot` placed on the rail): success, failure, progress (pulsing), warning or pending (dashed ring).

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label; defaults to the status name.

props.name: status
props.description: Omit for a neutral narration dot (hidden from assistive tech). Accepts `TaskStatus` values too.

ToolTimelineItem.description: One compact tool call row: icon, bold name, mono argument, meta and an expandable body (children).

props.name: name
props.description: Tool name, e.g. "Read", "Bash".

props.name: arg
props.description: Primary argument (path, command, pattern) in muted mono.

props.name: diffStat
props.description: Line counts shown as "+12 −3".

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration in milliseconds.

props.name: meta
props.description: Extra right-side meta.

props.name: runningLabel
props.description: Label while running (default "Running {name}…").

props.name: status
props.description: Default `success`. Accepts canonical `TaskStatus` values (`succeeded`, `failed`, `running`, `canceled`).

props.name: status
props.description: Optional status for the dot (narration usually has none).

Tooltip.description:
Tooltip root. Uses the nearest `TooltipProvider` (so skip-delay works across tooltips)
and falls back to its own provider when there is none.

TooltipContent.description: Floating tooltip bubble (dark inverse by default).

props.name: arrow
props.description: Show the pointing arrow. Default true.

TooltipProvider.description: Shares hover delay between tooltips. Mount once near the app root.

TooltipTrigger.description: Element that opens the tooltip on hover/focus.

ToolToggleList.description: Tool list with per-tool switches, filters, bulk actions, policy locks and a sticky unsaved-changes footer.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when no tool matches the search or filters. Default "No tools match".

props.name: hideToolbar
props.description: Hide the search + filter toolbar.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrolling list (keeps long lists cheap to lay out).

props.name: onDraftChange
props.description: Fires on every draft change.

props.name: onSave
props.type: (enabled: Record<string, boolean>, changed: string[]) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Called with the full enabled map and the ids that changed. May return a promise.

ToolToggleRow.description: One tool row: name, hint tags, lock state, switch and an expandable detail.

props.name: checked
props.description: Controlled switch state.

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial switch state when uncontrolled. Defaults to `tool.enabled`.

TopItemCard.description: StatCard preset for "the biggest item right now": label, item icon + name and its value, optionally linked.

props.name: item
props.description: The leading item's name ("Google Chrome").

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the icon chip, label, trend and progress bar. `tone` stays for status.

props.name: animate
props.description: Roll the digits when a numeric `value` changes. Opt-in; strings and nodes render as given.

props.name: caption
props.description: Small text above the value ("Now", "In use of 64 GB").

props.name: chevron
props.description: Trailing chevron in the header. Default true when the card is a link or button.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra body content under the value and stats (a chart, a list).

props.name: href
props.description: Makes the label a link that covers the whole card.

props.name: iconPlacement
props.description: Icon chip before the label or in the top-right corner. Default start with `accent`/`href`/`onClick`, else end.

props.name: itemIcon
props.description: The item's icon or logo.

props.name: label
props.description: Card label. Default "Top App".

props.name: labelTone
props.description: Label colour: the accent (default when `accent` is set) or muted.

props.name: loading
props.description:
Shows placeholders instead of the value, hint, delta and stat values (the label, caption and stat labels stay);
the progress bar, trend and `children` body get placeholders of the same size.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Makes the label a button that covers the whole card (when there is no `href`).

props.name: progress
props.description: A thin bar under the value (`progressMax` default 100).

props.name: status
props.description: Right-aligned next to the value, e.g. a `StatusBadge`.

props.name: trendMax
props.description: Fixed upper bound of the trend scale (e.g. 100).

props.name: trendMin
props.description: Fixed lower bound of the trend scale (e.g. 0).

props.name: trendPlacement
props.description: `footer` draws the trend full-width at the bottom on an accent-tinted strip. Default inline.

props.name: value
props.description: The item's value ("37.0%").

props.name: valueFont
props.description: Number face for the value: monospaced (default) or the UI sans with tabular figures.

props.name: valueFormat
props.description: `Intl.NumberFormat` options for an animated `value`.

props.name: valueLocale
props.description: Locale for an animated `value`.

TOTPCard.description: Authenticator entry: issuer icon, account label, live code and a menu slot.

props.name: code
props.description: Server-provided current code (overrides `secret`).

props.name: copyable
props.description: Show the copy button. Default true.

props.name: domain
props.description: Domain for the favicon (defaults to the issuer name, which renders a monogram).

props.name: getCode
props.description: Resolve a code for a timestamp (ms), e.g. from a server.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon node; replaces the favicon.

props.name: iconSrc
props.description: Explicit icon URL for the issuer.

props.name: menu
props.description: Slot for an overflow menu (e.g. a DropdownMenu trigger).

props.name: nextCode
props.description: Server-provided next code, shown near the end of the period.

props.name: nextThreshold
props.description: Seconds left at which the countdown turns red and the next code appears. Default 5.

props.name: onRollover
props.description: Called when the period rolls over.

props.name: secret
props.description: Base32 secret; codes are generated in the browser.

props.name: showNext
props.description: Preview the next code when fewer than `nextThreshold` seconds remain. Default true.

TOTPCode.description: Live one-time code with grouped digits, a countdown, copy and a next-code preview.

props.name: code
props.description: Server-provided current code (overrides `secret`).

props.name: copyable
props.description: Show the copy button. Default true.

props.name: getCode
props.description: Resolve a code for a timestamp (ms), e.g. from a server.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name prefix, e.g. "GitHub".

props.name: nextCode
props.description: Server-provided next code, shown near the end of the period.

props.name: nextThreshold
props.description: Seconds left at which the countdown turns red and the next code appears. Default 5.

props.name: onRollover
props.description: Called when the period rolls over.

props.name: secret
props.description: Base32 secret; codes are generated in the browser.

props.name: showNext
props.description: Preview the next code when fewer than `nextThreshold` seconds remain. Default true.

TrackCycleChip.description: Chip showing the current subtitle/audio track; click cycles to the next one or opens a picker.

props.name: allowOff
props.description: Include an "Off" option. Default true for subtitles.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial track id when uncontrolled. Default null (off).

props.name: mode
props.description: Click cycles through the options, or opens a menu. Default: cycle up to 3 options, menu beyond.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected track id, or null for off (subtitles). Controlled.

TrackRow.description: Track list row: number/now-playing bars, hover play, artwork, title/artist, album, duration and menu slot.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra inline actions shown on hover.

props.name: current
props.description: This row is the queue's current track.

props.name: index
props.description: 1-based number shown in the lead column.

props.name: menu
props.description: Trailing menu (e.g. a DropdownMenu trigger).

props.name: onPause
props.description: Pause when this is the current playing row (falls back to `onPlay`).

TranscriptSystemRow.description: System rows in a transcript: compaction, interruption, slash commands, errors, dividers and day changes.

props.name: action
props.description: divider: trailing action in the pill.

props.name: command
props.description: command: slash command name, e.g. "/review".

props.name: date
props.description: date: the day to show.

props.name: error
props.description: error: details.

props.name: result
props.description: command: output shown under the command.

props.name: summary
props.description: compaction: the summary revealed by "Show summary".

props.name: title
props.description: Overrides the default label for the kind.

TranscriptTimelineRail.description: Minimap rail beside a long transcript: one tick per user turn, hover previews, jump and in-view sync.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Controlled current turn; tracked via IntersectionObserver when omitted.

props.name: getTurnElement
props.description: Resolve a turn element. Default `document.getElementById(id)`.

props.name: onJump
props.description: Called on click / Enter; when omitted the turn element is scrolled into view.

props.name: scrollContainer
props.description: Scrollable transcript element (IntersectionObserver root and position source). Defaults to the viewport.

TranscriptTurn.description: A turn section whose sticky header stays pinned only while the turn is in view.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique id; the turn start anchor gets `${id}-start`.

TransferItem.description: One upload/download/job row: icon, name, progress, bytes, speed, ETA, status and actions.

props.name: status
props.description: Transfer state; canonical `TaskStatus` values and "cancelled" are accepted too.

props.name: bytes
props.description: Bytes transferred so far.

props.name: density
props.description: Row spacing. `compact` is the denser tray row. Default `normal`.

props.name: detail
props.description: Secondary text, e.g. a destination path.

props.name: error
props.description: Error shown for failed transfers (kept verbatim, e.g. upstream error text).

props.name: eta
props.description: Seconds remaining; computed from speed when omitted.

props.name: ext
props.description: Extension override for the file-format icon.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon instead of the file-format icon.

props.name: now
props.description: Override "now" (epoch ms) for speed computed from `startedAt`.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–100. Derived from `bytes / total` when omitted.

props.name: samples
props.description: Recent `{ t, bytes }` samples for a smoothed speed.

props.name: speed
props.description: Bytes per second; computed from `samples` or `startedAt` when omitted.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: Epoch ms when the transfer started.

props.name: total
props.description: Total bytes.

TransferList.description: Queue of transfers with a summary header ("3 active · 1 failed · 12.4 MB/s") and "Clear completed".

props.name: density
props.description: Row spacing. Default `normal`.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no items. Default "No transfers".

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrolling list.

props.name: now
props.description: Override "now" (epoch ms) for computed speeds.

props.name: onClearCompleted
props.description: Shows "Clear completed" when there are finished rows.

props.name: title
props.description: Group header title. Pass `null` to hide the header. Default "Transfers".

TransferTray.description: Floating, collapsible uploads/downloads panel pinned to a corner (Google Drive style).

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no items. Default "No transfers".

props.name: inline
props.description: Render in place instead of fixed to the viewport (for previews).

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrolling list.

props.name: now
props.description: Override "now" (epoch ms) for computed speeds.

props.name: onClearCompleted
props.description: Shows "Clear completed" when there are finished rows.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Shows a close button.

props.name: title
props.description: Header title; defaults to e.g. "Uploading 3 items" / "2 transfers complete".

TransliterationCandidates.description: IME-style candidate popup under the caret: pick by number, click, or arrows + Enter/Space; Esc keeps the raw text.

props.name: anchorRef
props.description: The textarea / input being typed in.

props.name: getCandidates
props.description: Return candidates for a romanized word. May be async.

props.name: enabled
props.description: IME on/off. Default true.

props.name: max
props.description: Max candidates shown (and number keys honored). Default 5.

TransliterationToggle.description: IME on/off toggle for transliteration input.

props.name: defaultPressed
props.description: Initial state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: glyph
props.description: Script sample shown on the button. Default "अ".

props.name: languageName
props.description: Language name for the label, e.g. "Hindi".

Treemap.description:
Squarified treemap: tiles sized by value, coloured by category, with hover/focus tooltips, arrow-key navigation,
drill-down (Enter, click) and up (Backspace, Escape, breadcrumb), an optional legend and a screen-reader table.

props.name: data
props.description: The root node; its children fill the map.

props.name: breadcrumb
props.description: Show the drill breadcrumb. Defaults to true when some top-level node has children.

props.name: colorFor
props.description: Tile colour (an accent name or any CSS colour). Defaults to the node's `color`, then its category's colour.

props.name: defaultWidth
props.description: Width used before the container is measured (and in jsdom). Default 600.

props.name: depth
props.description: Levels drawn below the current view. Deeper levels appear inside framed parents with a header. Default 1.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when nothing has a size. Default "No data".

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between tiles in px. Default 2.

props.name: height
props.description: Map height in px. Default 320.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the map and caption of its screen-reader table. Default "Treemap".

props.name: legend
props.description: Show a category legend (`BreakdownList`) under the map. Default false.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with nothing to draw, placeholder tiles (and legend rows) fill the map; otherwise the root is marked busy.

props.name: minLabelSize
props.description: Tiles narrower or shorter than this (px) hide their label. Default `{ width: 44, height: 22 }`.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a tile is clicked or activated with Enter/Space (before drilling into it).

props.name: palette
props.description: Category colours, cycled by the index of the top-level node. Defaults to a set of `ACCENT_COLORS`.

props.name: path
props.description: Drill path: child ids from the root down to the node shown.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Show a tooltip for the hovered or focused tile. Default true.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Column header for values in the screen-reader table. Default "Value".

TreeView.description: Data-driven tree with expand/collapse, selection, tri-state checkboxes and full keyboard support.

props.name: checkable
props.description: Show tri-state checkboxes. Checking a parent checks every descendant.

props.name: checked
props.description: Fully checked node ids (parents included).

props.name: expanded
props.description: Expanded node ids.

props.name: expandOnClick
props.description: Clicking a parent row toggles it. Default true.

props.name: indentGuides
props.description: Vertical indent guide lines. Default true.

props.name: onNodeAction
props.description: Fired on click or Enter.

props.name: selectionMode
props.description: Default "single".

props.name: showIcons
props.description: Default folder/file icons when a node has no `icon`. Default true.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Jump to nodes by typing their first letters. Default true.

TrustBadge.description: Trust scale badge (verified → flagged) with a tooltip explaining what the level means.

props.name: explanation
props.description: Override the tooltip explanation.

props.name: showScale
props.description: Show a 5-step scale next to the label.

TurnStickyHeader.description: User prompt pinned at the top of the scroll area while its turn scrolls; click to jump to the turn start.

props.name: prompt
props.description: The user's prompt for this turn.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Level of the visually hidden heading. Default 2.

props.name: index
props.description: 1-based turn number for the screen-reader heading.

props.name: targetId
props.description: Id of the element marking the start of the turn; clicking scrolls it into view.

TwoFactorSetupCard.description: Authenticator app setup: scan a QR code or copy the secret, then confirm with a 6-digit code.

props.name: account
props.description: Account label shown under the QR code.

props.name: description
props.default: "Protect your account with an authenticator app like 1Password, Authy or Google Authenticator."

props.name: footer
props.description: Replace the default footer (e.g. "Don't have an account? Sign up"). Pass `null` to hide it.

props.name: issuer
props.description: Issuer (service name) shown in the authenticator app. Defaults to "Sutra".

props.name: logo
props.description: Show the Sutra mark above the title, or pass a custom logo. Default: true for `card`.

props.name: otpauthUri
props.description:
Full `otpauth://` provisioning URI encoded in the QR code. Defaults to one built from
`issuer`, `account` and `secret` (TOTP). Pass your server's URI to include digits/period/algorithm.

props.name: recoveryCodes
props.description: Recovery codes revealed after a successful verification.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Router link renderer for the footer and inline links.

props.name: secret
props.description: Base32 secret shown for manual entry (spaces are ignored when copying).

props.name: variant
props.description: `card` renders a bordered surface; `plain` renders only the content (for full-page layouts).

Typewriter.description:
Text that types itself (see `useTypewriter` for the timing options). Accessible: the current line is real text in a
visually hidden span and the typed part and the caret are `aria-hidden`, so a screen reader reads the whole line
once, never letter by letter, and the hidden text is there before the first character. Under
`prefers-reduced-motion` it prints the finished text straight away.

props.name: text
props.description: One line, or several typed in turn.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. Default `span`.

props.name: cursor
props.description:
The caret. "typing" (default): a solid caret while the text is being typed, gone when it is done, so nothing blinks
at rest. "always": a blinking caret that stays (it stops under reduced motion). "none".

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds before the first character. Default 0.

props.name: deleteSpeed
props.description: Milliseconds per deleted character. Default 25.

props.name: hold
props.description: Milliseconds a finished line is held before it is deleted (several lines only). Default 1600.

props.name: loop
props.description: With several lines, start over after the last one (it is deleted first). Default false: the last line stays.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called when the last line has been typed (never with `loop`).

props.name: reserve
props.description: Keep the space of the longest line from the start, so the text below does not jump while this one grows.

props.name: speed
props.description: Milliseconds per typed character. Default 45.

TypingIndicator.description: Polite live region announcing who is typing, with bouncing dots (`Spinner variant="dots"`).

props.name: users
props.description: People currently typing: names or presence users.

props.name: hideDots
props.description: Hide the animated dots.

props.name: maxNames
props.description: Names listed before "and N others". Default 2.

UndeliveredNotice.description: Inline notice when an answer or message couldn't be delivered, with Retry.

UndoAction.description:
A destructive button that turns into a counted "Undo" for N seconds and only then commits (`onCommit`). The deadline is the
wall clock, so a throttled tab still commits on time; the ring and the number follow it. The focus stays on the same button, so
Enter or Space undoes. Pair it with a `Toast` through `onArm` and a controlled `armed`. The three labels sit in one grid cell,
so the width never jumps. A polite live region announces the countdown, the undo and the commit.

props.name: onCommit
props.description: Runs once the countdown ends (not before). A returned promise shows a spinner; a rejection brings the button back.

props.name: armed
props.description: The countdown is running. Set it from outside (a toast's Undo button sets it to false).

props.name: armedVariant
props.description: Variant while the countdown runs. Default "secondary".

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon before the idle label.

props.name: label
props.description: Label of the idle button. Default "Delete".

props.name: messages
props.type: { armed?: (seconds: number) => string; undone?: string; committed?: string }
props.description: Screen reader messages (a polite live region).

props.name: onArm
props.description: Runs when the user presses the button and the countdown starts (start a `Toast` here).

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Runs when the user presses "Undo". Setting a controlled `armed` to false from outside cancels silently.

props.name: pauseOnFocus
props.description: Hold the countdown while the button has keyboard focus (focus that came from a click does not count).

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Hold the countdown while the pointer is over the button.

props.name: seconds
props.description: Seconds the user has to undo. Default 8.

props.name: spinnerProps
props.description: Overrides for the loading spinner (variant, size, `label`, colour via `className`); it inherits the button text colour by default.

UpgradeDialog.description: Plan comparison dialog with a monthly/yearly toggle and feature checklists.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Element that opens the dialog (rendered with `asChild`).

UptimeBar.description: Status-page uptime strip: N buckets colored up / degraded / down / no-data, with uptime %.

props.name: height
props.description: Bar height in px. Default 32.

props.name: label
props.description: Service name shown above the bar.

props.name: percent
props.description: Override the computed uptime.

UsageInvoiceTable.description: Invoice history: date, description, amount, paid/due/failed status and download / pay actions.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no invoices. Default "No invoices yet".

UsageLimitBars.description: Rolling usage-limit bars with threshold coloring, reset captions, a window toggle and per-model attribution.

props.name: models
props.description: Per-model attribution ("Opus 62% of usage").

props.name: views
props.description: Toggle options for the window views, e.g. Session / Weekly.

UsageSummary.description: Usage dashboard: range switch, KPI tiles, daily bars, per-model bars, wait vs generate and finish reasons.

props.name: days
props.description: Daily records, oldest first.

UserAccountMenu.description: Avatar-triggered account menu: profile header, settings, theme submenu and sign out.

props.name: showTheme
props.description: Show the theme submenu. Default true.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Custom trigger element (e.g. a `SidebarUserCard`). Defaults to an avatar button.

VersionHistory.description:
Version history: timeline grouped by day with contributors and named versions; click to see what
changed in a version, Shift-click a second to compare the range, preview, rename and restore.

props.name: versions
props.description: Newest first.

props.name: defaultDiffMode
props.description: Initial diff layout when uncontrolled. Default "inline".

props.name: diffMode
props.description: Diff layout. Default "inline".

props.name: now
props.description: Reference time for day grouping.

props.name: onRename
props.description: Enables "Name this version" (empty string clears the name).

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Enables Restore (after a confirmation).

props.name: renderContent
props.description: Custom preview of a single version (default: plain text).

props.name: markOnly
props.description: Render only the geometric mark.

props.name: size
props.description: Height-driven size of the lockup.

VideoPlayer.description:
Custom `<video>` player: auto-hiding gradient chrome, seek bar with previews, volume, subtitle/audio chips,
speed, PiP/AirPlay/fullscreen, scoped keyboard shortcuts, autoplay-muted fallback, resume and up-next.

props.name: audioTracks
props.description: Server-side audio tracks (you reload the stream in `onAudioTrackChange`). Without this, native `audioTracks` are used.

props.name: autoHideMs
props.description: Hide the chrome after this much inactivity while playing. Default 3000ms.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Try to start playing; falls back to muted playback and shows a "tap to unmute" pill.

props.name: muted
props.description: Start muted.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Shows a back button in the top bar (also fired by Escape).

props.name: onNext
props.description: Shows a "next" button and enables the up-next countdown.

props.name: resumeAt
props.description: Offer to resume from this position (seconds). Ignored under 5s.

props.name: skipSeconds
props.description: Skip button distance. Default 10s.

props.name: topActions
props.description: Extra controls in the top bar (e.g. a CastPicker).

props.name: tracks
props.description: Side-loaded WebVTT tracks. Without this, the element's own text tracks are offered.

props.name: upNext
props.description: When set (with `onNext`), ending playback shows an "Up next in 5…" card.

props.name: upNextCountdown
props.description: Countdown seconds for the up-next card. Default 5.

VoiceInput.description: Mic toggle with a live input-level ring, timer + max-duration countdown and interim transcript preview.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Rendered instead of nothing when speech recognition is unavailable.

props.name: maxDuration
props.description: Auto-stop after this many seconds. Default 60.

props.name: meter
props.description: Capture the mic for the level meter. Default true.

props.name: onTranscript
props.description: Called with each finalized phrase (`done: false`) and with the whole transcript when dictation stops (`done: true`).

props.name: showTranscript
props.description: Show the interim transcript preview. Default true.

VolumeControl.description:
Mute toggle plus a volume slider that expands on hover/focus (or pops up vertically).
A preset over `VolumeSlider`: media button style, 0–1 volume, arrow keys on the toggle, and the reveal / popover layout.

props.name: expand
props.description: Reveal the horizontal slider on hover/focus, or always show it. Default "hover".

props.name: orientation
props.description: Horizontal slider beside the button, or a vertical slider in a popover above it.

props.name: step
props.description: Volume change per arrow key. Default 0.05.

VolumeMixer.description:
Sound mixer: an output card (device picker, master volume) over a table of apps with their status,
a per-app `VolumeSlider` and level. Data in, events out.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour for the icon chip, sliders and playing indicator. Default "pink".

props.name: device
props.description: Selected device id.

props.name: devices
props.description: Output devices for the picker. With one device or none, the name is shown as plain text.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when `apps` is empty. Default "No apps using audio".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the apps table. Default "App volumes".

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way. With no apps yet the card and table show placeholders; with apps the root is only marked busy.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Placeholder app rows while loading. Default 3.

props.name: outputLabel
props.description: Header title. Default "Output".

props.name: volume
props.description: Master output volume 0–100.

VolumeSlider.description:
Volume control: a mute toggle (speaker icon by level), a `Slider` and the level ("64%" or "Muted").
Muting keeps the value, so unmuting restores it; moving the slider while muted unmutes.

props.name: accent
props.description: Categorical colour of the range and thumb. Default primary.

props.name: hideMuteButton
props.description: Hide the mute toggle (the slider alone). Default false.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the slider, e.g. "Music volume". Default "Volume".

props.name: levelClassName
props.description: Class for the level label.

props.name: muteButtonClassName
props.description: Class for the mute toggle, merged last (e.g. another button style).

props.name: muteLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the mute toggle. Default `Mute ${label}`.

props.name: muteToggle
props.description:
How the toggle exposes its state: `"pressed"` (default) keeps one name with `aria-pressed`;
`"label"` swaps its name between `muteLabel` and `unmuteLabel`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Slider direction. Vertical stacks the toggle, slider and level in a column. Default "horizontal".

props.name: renderSlider
props.description: Wrap the slider, e.g. in a reveal-on-hover container or a popover.

props.name: restoreOnUnmute
props.description: Value to set when the toggle unmutes a level of 0 (the toggle then reads as "unmute" at 0). Default: none.

props.name: showLevel
props.description: Show the level ("64%", or "Muted") after the slider. Default true.

props.name: sliderClassName
props.description: Class for the slider.

props.name: step
props.description: Keyboard step. Default 1.

props.name: unmuteLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the toggle when it unmutes (`muteToggle="label"`). Default `Unmute ${label}`.

props.name: value
props.description: Volume 0–100.

props.name: zeroWhenMuted
props.description: Show the slider at 0 while muted instead of keeping the stored level. Default false.

WaterfallChart.description: Waterfall chart: floating bars that climb and fall from the running total, with totals, connectors and a signed table.

props.name: data
props.description:
One row per step. A row is a change (added to the running total; negative values fall) unless its `type` is
`"total"` (or `"subtotal"`): that bar rises from zero to its `value`, or to the running total when it has none.

props.name: animate
props.description: CSS transitions on data changes (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion). Default true.

props.name: colors
props.description: Bar colors (token names or any CSS color). Defaults: success, destructive, primary.

props.name: connectors
props.description: Dashed lines linking each bar to the next. Default true.

props.name: grid
props.description: Horizontal gridlines. Default true.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px (legend excluded). Default 260.

props.name: index
props.description: Key of the step name. Default "label".

props.name: kindLabels
props.description: Legend and table wording. Defaults "Increase", "Decrease", "Total".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Defaults to a description built from the steps.

props.name: legend
props.description: Increase / decrease / total key. Default: shown below when more than one kind is present.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with no data, a placeholder plot (and legend) of the same size; with data, the root is marked busy.

props.name: referenceLines
props.description: Horizontal threshold lines (`axis: "y"` only).

props.name: showValues
props.description: Value labels above the bars: `"auto"` (default) shows them when they fit.

props.name: typeKey
props.description: Key of the step type. Default "type".

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats a magnitude: changes get their sign added ("+18", "−18"), totals are formatted as they are.

props.name: valueKey
props.description: Key of the step value. Default "value".

props.name: xAxis
props.description: Step name axis: `hide`, `formatter`, `label` (table header) and `tickCount` (a maximum).

WebhookRouteEditor.description: Create or edit a webhook route: name, URL, show-once signing secret with regenerate, events, delivery, test send and recent deliveries.

props.name: events
props.description: Events a sender can subscribe to.

props.name: newSecret
props.description: Freshly issued signing secret: shown once, then masked.

props.name: onRegenerateSecret
props.description: Issue a new secret (after confirmation); the result is shown once.

props.name: route
props.description: Existing route; omit to create one.

WebhookRouteList.description: Webhook routes: name, copyable URL, events, delivery target, last delivery and an enabled switch.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no routes. Default "No webhook routes yet".

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Shows a "New route" button.

WebhookUrlCopy.description: Read-only monospace value with a copy button (endpoint URLs).

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the copy button. Default "Copy URL".

WebToolBody.description: Web fetch / search body: favicon, domain, title and an optional excerpt.

props.name: snippet
props.description: Short excerpt or result summary.

WheelPicker.description:
An iOS-style wheel for one list of values (time, duration, amount, day): the rows scroll with the mouse wheel or a
finger and snap one at a time (CSS scroll-snap with `scroll-snap-stop: always`, so a fling cannot skip rows), the row
in the centre is the value once the scroll stops. It is a `role="listbox"` with the selected row as
`aria-activedescendant`: Arrow keys move one row, Page keys five, Home and End jump to the ends, typing selects by
prefix, clicking a row selects it. Disabled rows are skipped. Controlled (`value`) or uncontrolled (`defaultValue`);
under reduced motion the keys jump instead of gliding. The accessible name comes from `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: band
props.description: Draw the highlight band behind the centre row (a `WheelPickerGroup` draws one band across its columns). Default true.

props.name: emptyState
props.description: Shown when there are no options. Default "No options".

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Row height in px. Default 36.

props.name: listClassName
props.description: Class names for the scrolling listbox.

props.name: loading
props.description: Options are on their way: placeholder rows and `aria-busy`, no listbox.

props.name: visibleCount
props.description: Rows in view (odd; an even number is raised by one). Default 5.

WheelPickerGroup.description:
Several wheels read as one value (hours : minutes : period, or hours and minutes of a duration) with one highlight
band across them. `value` is an array with one entry per column. Each column is a `WheelPicker`, so the keys, type-ahead
and reduced-motion behaviour are the same; the group is a labelled `role="group"`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (value: string[], meta: { columnId: string; index: number }) => void

props.name: value
props.description: One value per column, in order.

WorkspaceProfileSwitcher.description: Two-level gateway → profile switcher with search, reachability and latency.

props.name: allowUnreachable
props.description: Allow picking profiles on unreachable gateways. Default false.

props.name: onNewProfile
props.description: "New profile" action; receives the gateway of the current selection.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: (value: WorkspaceSelection, detail: { gateway: WorkspaceGateway; profile: WorkspaceProfile }) => void

WorkspaceSwitcher.description: Workspace picker: current workspace with its app icon, a checked list and "Create workspace".

props.name: variant
props.description: `sidebar` is a full-width row (collapses to an icon in an icon sidebar); `compact` is a small inline button.

WorktreeDialog.description: Create a git worktree: name, base branch picker (recent / local / remote), path preview and session switch.

props.name: error
props.description: Server-side error (e.g. from `git worktree add`).

props.name: existingNames
props.description: Names already taken by branches or worktrees. Branch names are always included.

props.name: pathFor
props.description: Custom path preview.

props.name: worktreeRoot
props.description: Folder new worktrees go in. Default "../worktrees".

WorldMap.description:
Flat world map from bundled outlines (no network): a choropleth with a stepped legend, marker buttons (dots, icons
or avatars, optionally clustered), animated great-circle arcs, country tooltips and selection, and screen-reader tables.

props.name: cluster
props.description: Merge nearby markers into count bubbles (`{ radius }` in px, default 36; 48 for compact markers).

props.name: color
props.description: Colour token or any CSS colour for the choropleth. Default `primary`.

props.name: compactMarkers
props.description: Smaller markers and a wider cluster radius. Default: on when the drawing is narrower than 480 px.

props.name: data
props.description: Choropleth values by country.

props.name: dataTable
props.description:
Render the visually hidden screen-reader tables (countries, markers, arcs). Default true. Set false when the page
already lists the same data accessibly next to the map (as LiveVisitorsMap, SignInMap and RegionStatusMap do).

props.name: defaultWidth
props.description: Width used before the container is measured (and in jsdom). Default 640.

props.name: domain
props.description: Value range for `quantize`. Defaults to the data's min and max.

props.name: graticule
props.description: Draw 10° graticule lines.

props.name: height
props.description: Height in px. Defaults to the projection's aspect at the measured width.

props.name: hideAntarctica
props.description: Leave Antarctica out and fit the map to the other land. Default true.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; defaults to a summary ("World map: 12 countries with data, 16 markers"). `aria-label` also works.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the stepped scale legend under the map.

props.name: loading
props.description: Data is on its way: with nothing to show yet, a pulsing silhouette stands in; otherwise the map is marked busy.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for country names. Default English.

props.name: markerSizeRange
props.description: Diameter range in px for `value`-scaled markers. Default `[8, 28]`.

props.name: noDataColor
props.description: Fill for countries without data. Default `var(--muted)`.

props.name: onCountrySelect
props.type: (code: string | null, country: WorldMapCountry | undefined) => void
props.description: Called with the clicked country, or `null` when the selected one is clicked again.

props.name: onMarkerSelect
props.type: (id: string | null, marker: GeoMarker | undefined) => void

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the map in px. Default 4.

props.name: projection
props.description: Map projection. Default `equalEarth`.

props.name: scale
props.description: Bucketing: `quantize` (equal ranges, default) or `quantile` (equal counts).

props.name: selectedCountry
props.description: Highlighted country (alpha-2 code). Clicking a country selects it when this, `defaultSelectedCountry` or `onCountrySelect` is set.

props.name: sphere
props.description: Draw the outline of the globe.

props.name: steps
props.description: Number of colour buckets. Default 5.

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Hover tooltips for countries and markers. Default true.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: Name of the value in the tooltip, legend and table. Default "Value".

ZoneEditor.description: FancyZones-style editor: click to split zones (Shift for horizontal), drag dividers, delete zones.

props.name: defaultLayout
props.description: Starting arrangement (panes are ignored). Default: two columns.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Minimum zone fraction per split. Default 0.1.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every edit with the zone tree.

props.name: panes
props.description: When given, the applied layout has these panes filled into the zones in order.

ZoomPan.description: Zoom & pan viewport for images, diagrams or SVG, with a controls overlay.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the zoom controls overlay. Default true.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the zoomable region. Default "Zoomable content".

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new scale and offset after every zoom or pan.

props.name: panStep
props.description: Pixels per arrow-key pan. Default 40.

props.name: step
props.description: Multiplier per zoom step (buttons / keys). Default 1.25.

props.name: wheelRequiresModifier
props.description: Require Ctrl/⌘ for wheel zoom (so the page can still scroll). Default false.

useActiveIndicator.description:
Measures the active item of a tab strip / segmented control for a sliding indicator.
`getActive` is a selector (queried inside the container) or a function returning the element.
Re-measures when `deps` change, when the container or its items resize, and on `watchAttributes` mutations.
Items are re-collected for the resize observer whenever `deps` change, so items added later are watched too.
useActiveIndicator.signature: <T extends HTMLElement>(containerRef: RefObject<T | null>, getActive: string | ((container: T) => HTMLElement | null | undefined), deps?: DependencyList, options?: UseActiveIndicatorOptions): ActiveIndicatorState

useAgentNow.description: Current time, re-rendered every `interval` ms while `active`.

useAsyncAction.description:
Tracks a possibly-async action: `busy`, `error`, and a stable `run`.
Errors are caught (no unhandled rejections); results of superseded runs and after unmount are ignored.
useAsyncAction.signature: <A extends unknown[] = [], R = unknown>(fn?: ((...args: A) => R | PromiseLike<R>) | undefined, options?: UseAsyncActionOptions<Awaited<R>>): AsyncAction<A, Awaited<R>>

useAudioLevel.description: Live RMS input level (0..1) of a MediaStream, sampled each animation frame. Returns 0 without a stream.
useAudioLevel.signature: (stream: MediaStream | null | undefined, { smoothing, gain }?: { smoothing?: number | undefined; gain?: number | undefined; }): number

useBreakpoint.description: True when the viewport is at least the named breakpoint's width (`min-width`, from the tokens).

useCamera.description:
Opens a camera with getUserMedia and tracks permission and errors. Every start is guarded so a
superseded or unmounted run (StrictMode, fast toggles) releases what it acquired.

props.name: audio
props.description: Also capture audio (for recording). Default false.

props.name: constraints
props.description: Extra video constraints merged into the request (resolution, frame rate …).

props.name: deviceId
props.description: A specific camera (`exact`); takes precedence over `facingMode`.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Run the camera. When false the stream is released and the status is `"idle"`. Default true.

props.name: facingMode
props.description: Camera to ask for first (`ideal`, so a device without it still opens). Default `"environment"`.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the raw error when the camera can't be opened.

useCaretAnchor.description: Position a fixed popup under (or above) the caret of a field, re-measured on scroll/resize.
useCaretAnchor.signature: (ref: RefObject<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement | null>, position: number | null, open: boolean): { top: number; left: number; height: number; } | null

useChatConversation.description: Access the enclosing ChatConversation's scroll state.

useChatMessage.description: Read the enclosing message's role, variant and streaming state.

useCommandMenuShortcut.description:
Toggles a command menu with ⌘/Ctrl + `key` (default "k"). Registers in the shortcut registry when a
`ShortcutProvider` is present; otherwise uses its own listener.

useComposerHistory.description: Shell-style prompt history for composers: ↑/↓ recall previous prompts when the caret is at the start / end.
useComposerHistory.signature: ({ value, onValueChange, initialEntries, max }: UseComposerHistoryOptions): ComposerHistory

props.name: initialEntries
props.description: Seed entries, oldest first.

props.name: max
props.description: Keep at most this many entries. Default 100.

useControllableState.description:
State that can be controlled (value + onChange) or uncontrolled (defaultValue).
Functional updates compose within a tick (`set(v => v + 1)` twice adds 2) and the setter is stable.
useControllableState.signature: <T>({ value, defaultValue, onChange, }: { value?: T | undefined; defaultValue: T; onChange?: ((value: T) => void) | undefined; }): readonly [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void]

useCopy.description: Copy text to the clipboard; `copied` flips true for `timeout` ms.
useCopy.signature: (timeout?: number): { copied: boolean; copy: (text: string) => Promise<boolean>; }

useCountdown.description: Time left until `deadline`, recomputed from the wall clock on every tick (no drift).

useDebouncedValue.description:
A copy of `value` that follows it after it has stopped changing for `delay` ms (default 300). Feed it a search box
value and fetch on the debounced one. The first render returns `value` untouched, a pending update is dropped when
the component unmounts, and a `delay` of 0 or less updates on the next tick.

useDialogs.description:
Promise-based `confirm`, `prompt` and `choose` (`if (!(await confirm("Delete?"))) return;`).
Throws when no `DialogProvider` is mounted above.

useDirection.description:
The reading direction components should assume: the nearest `DirectionProvider` with a `dir`, else the `dir` of the document
(`<html dir>`, followed live), else `"ltr"`. Pass a ref to read the nearest `dir` ancestor of that element instead (a chart
pinned to `dir="ltr"` inside an RTL page). The server renders `"ltr"` and the value settles after hydration.

useDirectoryPickerSupport.description: `supportsDirectoryPicker()` as a hook: `false` on the server and during hydration, then the real answer.

useDisclosure.description: Open/close state for any overlay or disclosure, controlled or uncontrolled, with stable handlers.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when uncontrolled (default false).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next state whenever it changes through `onOpen`, `onClose`, `toggle`, `setOpen` or `props`.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

useDrag.description:
Tracks a pointer drag: the offset follows the finger through CSS variables (no React state per move), with an axis lock,
bounds with elastic, a release velocity from a 100 ms window, `settle` with the spring maths and a click guard after a drag.
Spread `handlers` on an element, pass `ref` to it. A press that never passes `threshold` is a plain click. The pointer is
captured only once the drag starts; `pointercancel`, a lost capture and a disabled hook end it. The hook sets `touch-action`
on the element (`pan-y` for horizontal drags, `pan-x` for vertical ones, `none` for both).

props.name: allow
props.description: Asked on press; return false to ignore the whole gesture (a slider, a text field, a scrolled area).

props.name: axis
props.description: Axis that follows the finger; the other is left to native scrolling (the hook sets `touch-action`). Default "both".

props.name: bounds
props.description: Limits of the offset. A single-axis drag whose cross axis wins at the start is handed back to the page.

props.name: elastic
props.description: Resistance beyond `bounds`: a 0..1 factor of the overshoot (0 = hard stop) or a curve. Default 0.

props.name: lockAxis
props.description: With `axis="both"`: decide the axis after `lockDistance` px and follow it only. Needs `touch-action: none`.

props.name: lockDistance
props.description: Distance used by `lockAxis`. Default 8.

props.name: mouse
props.description: Also drag with the mouse (touch and pen always count). Default true.

props.name: onDown
props.description: Called on every accepted press, before any travel (stop an inertia loop here).

props.name: onEnd
props.description: Release (or `cancelled` for `pointercancel` and a lost capture): decide to commit or call `settle`.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Runs on every pointer move (pointer events are frame-aligned by the browser, so it is already once per frame).

props.name: onPosition
props.description: Runs whenever the offset changes (drag, settle frame, `set`), for consumers that write a style of their own.

props.name: shouldStart
props.description: Asked once when the travel passes the threshold; return false to hand the gesture back.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Pointer travel (px) before a press becomes a drag; below it taps and clicks go through. Default 4.

useElementSize.description: Border-box size of an element, updated on resize (`{0, 0}` until measured).

useElementWidth.description: Border-box width of an element, updated on resize (0 until measured).

useEmbedConsent.description: Read remembered embed consent (null outside an EmbedConsentProvider).

useField.description:
Wires a form control to the nearest `Field`: id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid,
disabled and required. Explicit props always win over the field context.

useFieldContext.description: Read the surrounding field context, or `null` outside a `Field`.

useFileUpload.description: Access the nearest `FileUpload` state (files, add/remove, picker).

useFlip.description:
FLIP for a list: pass the ordered keys and put `register(key)` on each element. When the keys change (a reorder, an
insert, a removal), the elements that moved glide from their old place to the new one with WAAPI (`translate`, plus
`scale` when asked), on the motion tokens, so a style that retunes them retunes this. Positions are measured relative
to the parent, an animation still in flight is cancelled and continued from where the element is, and nothing is
measured or animated under `prefers-reduced-motion` (the list just changes) or where `animate` is missing (jsdom).
Cancels on unmount; StrictMode's second run measures the same boxes, which is no move.

useFocusView.description: Read the focus-view state. Returns an inert "not focused" value outside a provider.

useInstallPrompt.description: Captures `beforeinstallprompt` and tracks whether the PWA is installed.

useIsoLayoutEffect.description: `useLayoutEffect` in the browser, `useEffect` on the server (no SSR warning).

useKunjiSignIn.description: State machine for kunji sign-in: idle → loading → ready → scanned → success | expired | denied | notLinked | error.
useKunjiSignIn.signature: ({ client, onSuccess, onError, onStatusChange, autoStart, slowAfter, successDelay, pollInterval, }: UseKunjiSignInOptions): UseKunjiSignInReturn

props.name: autoStart
props.description: Start a session on mount. Default true.

props.name: onSuccess
props.description: Called after the success animation with the approved poll result.

props.name: pollInterval
props.description: Override the client's poll interval.

props.name: slowAfter
props.description: Mark the attempt `slow` after this many ms of loading or awaiting approval. Default 15000. 0 disables.

props.name: successDelay
props.description: Delay between the success state and `onSuccess`, for the animation. Default 900ms.

useLatestRef.description: A ref that always holds the latest value (updated before effects run), for stable callbacks.

useLightbox.description: Imperative control for a `Lightbox`: `const lb = useLightbox(); lb.openAt(2); <Lightbox items={…} {...lb.props} />`.
useLightbox.signature: (initialIndex?: number): { open: boolean; index: number; openAt: (i?: number) => void; close: () => void; setIndex: Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>; props: { open: boolean; onOpenChange: Dispatch<SetStateAction<boolean>>; index: number; onIndexChange: Dispatch<SetStateAction<number>>; }; }

useMarqueeSelection.description:
Rubber-band selection: drag on empty space inside `containerRef` to draw a rectangle and select the items it
touches. Shift-drag adds to the selection, Mod-drag (⌘ / Ctrl) toggles, a plain click on empty space clears, and
dragging near the edges scrolls the container. Presses on items or interactive elements are left alone, so item
clicks and drag-and-drop keep working.

props.name: containerRef
props.description: The scrollable (or static) element the marquee is drawn in. Give it `position: relative` to render `box`.

props.name: autoScroll
props.description: Scroll the container while dragging near its edges. `edge` is the zone in px, `speed` the max px per frame.

props.name: clearOnClick
props.description: A plain click on empty space clears the selection. Default true.

props.name: getItemId
props.description: Reads an item's id. Default: its `data-selection-id`, else its `id`.

props.name: getItems
props.description: Supplies the items directly (wins over `itemSelector`), e.g. `files.map(f => ({ id, element: byId(id) }))`.

props.name: ignoreSelector
props.description: Extra selector for elements a drag must not start on (added to `MARQUEE_IGNORE_SELECTOR`).

props.name: itemSelector
props.description: CSS selector for selectable items inside the container. Default `[data-selection-id]`.

props.name: mode
props.description: Whether an item must touch (`intersect`, default) or lie fully inside (`contain`) the marquee.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Pointer travel in px before a press becomes a marquee (so clicks stay clicks). Default 4.

props.name: touch
props.description: Start marquees from touch too. Off by default so touch drags keep scrolling; set `touch-action: none` when on.

props.name: value
props.description: Selected ids (controlled).

useMediaElement.description:
Subscribes to an `HTMLMediaElement` (or any `MediaElementLike`) and exposes its state plus imperative actions.
Autoplay refusals fall back to muted playback and raise `autoplayMuted`.
useMediaElement.signature: (target: MediaElementLike | RefObject<MediaElementLike | null> | RefObject<HTMLMediaElement | null> | null, options?: UseMediaElementOptions): UseMediaElementResult

useMediaPortalContainer.description: The element media menus portal into, or null for `document.body`.

useMediaQuery.description: Whether a CSS media query matches, kept in sync (SSR-safe via `useSyncExternalStore`).

useMergedRefs.description: `mergeRefs` with a stable identity while the refs themselves don't change (avoids ref churn on every render).

useMountedRef.description: A ref that is true while mounted: set on (re)mount, false after unmount (StrictMode-safe).

useNoticeQueue.description: Queue state for `RotatingNoticeBar`: dedupe by id, priority sort and a dismissed set.

useNow.description: Current time in epoch ms, re-rendering every `interval` ms while `active` (or the `fixed` time).

props.name: active
props.description: Tick only while true. Default true.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Freeze the clock at this time (tests, stories, server snapshots).

props.name: interval
props.description: Tick interval in ms. Default 1000.

useObjectUrl.description:
An object URL for a Blob or File, revoked when the source changes or the component unmounts. Returns undefined
for no source, until the URL is created, and during the first render on the server. See `useObjectUrlState`.

useObjectUrlState.description:
An object URL for a Blob or File plus a pending flag. The URL is created in an effect (StrictMode-safe), revoked
when the source changes or the component unmounts, and never returned for a source other than the current one
(so a revoked URL is never rendered). Without `URL.createObjectURL` (old runtimes, some test setups) it settles
on `url: undefined`.

useOnlineStatus.description: Tracks `navigator.onLine` with online/offline events. Renders `true` on the server and during hydration.

props.name: boundaryCount
props.description: Pages always shown at the start and end. Default 1.

props.name: siblingCount
props.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page. Default 1.

usePan.description:
Drag with inertia: a release keeps its velocity and slows down with time-based friction; past the bounds it springs back.
Built on `useDrag` (offset in `--sutra-drag-x` / `--sutra-drag-y`, no React state per move). A press stops the glide.
Under reduced motion following the finger still works but a release stops at once.
usePan.signature: ({ axis, friction, bounds, elastic, spring, onChange, mouse, enabled, allow, }?: UsePanOptions): PanBinding

props.name: elastic
props.description: Pull beyond the bounds while dragging (0..1 factor or a curve). Default 0.4.

props.name: friction
props.description: Friction per second: the speed decays as `v * exp(-friction * dt)`, so it feels the same at any frame rate. Default 6.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Runs whenever the offset changes.

props.name: spring
props.description: Spring used to settle back inside the bounds and by `to()`. Default "gentle".

usePlayerQueue.description: Queue state for a player: current item, play order and next/previous with repeat & shuffle semantics.
usePlayerQueue.signature: <T extends PlayerQueueItem>(options?: UsePlayerQueueOptions<T>): { dispatch: (action: PlayerQueueAction<T>) => PlayerQueueState<T>; current: T | null; ordered: T[]; position: number; upNext: T[]; hasNext: boolean; hasPrevious: boolean; next: (opts?: { auto?: boolean | undefined; }) => T | null; previous: (opts?: { currentTime?: number | undefined; restartAfter?: number | undefined; }) => T | null…

props.name: index
props.description: Start index in `items` (ignored when `currentId` is set). Default 0.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next queue state after every change.

props.name: rng
props.description: Random source for shuffling (inject for deterministic tests). Default Math.random.

usePointerVars.description:
